jobs.title: Mid-Market Implementation Specialist - Americas
jobs.summary: Mid-Market Implementation Specialist Hi, I’m Daryl and I’m the Manager of Mid-Market Implementations at Ashby.
jobs.description:
Mid-Market Implementation Specialist

Hi, I’m Daryl and I’m the Manager of Mid-Market Implementations at Ashby. One of my favorite aspects of Ashby is our operating principle of Continuous Improvement. Coupled with our principle of caring deeply about our customers, we often find ourselves wondering, “What is a better way to accomplish this?”. That’s why I am thrilled to be hiring a Mid-Market Implementation Specialist!

As a member of the Mid-Market Implementation team and part of our growing Professional Services team within Ashby’s Customer Success organization, you’ll have a unique opportunity to help shape this new implementation offering and uplevel the overall customer experience.

About this role:

As an Implementation Specialist aligned to our Mid-Market segment, you will be responsible for managing and executing the end-to-end implementation of Ashby’s solution for Mid-Market and smaller enterprise customers. Your book of business will include about 15 active implementations at a time, each lasting 4-8 weeks. You will work directly with customers to develop and execute implementation plans that ensure a positive customer experience and expedited time to value. Your goal is to support our customers, helping them get up and running swiftly with Ashby so they can achieve their desired outcomes.

Role requirements:

-
Implementation & Project Management: You have extensive experience leading implementation and onboarding projects in high growth B2B SaaS environments, defining scope, aligning stakeholders, communicating project plans, and delivering results against agreed upon expectations. You keep teams on track to meet milestones, work effectively in a remote first setting, and are willing to travel Technical Proficiency: You have experience with complex, multi-module SaaS systems, understand shared configuration and data models, and are comfortable with analytics, conditional logic, and relational data (Ashby knowledge is a plus but not required)

-
Customer Centricity: You deeply understand customer needs and tailor implementations to meet their specific requirements. You build strong customer relationships by maintaining high levels of engagement and communication; you’re the customer’s proactive guide and advocate throughout the implementation period.

-
Change Management: You are experienced in navigating change management processes and helping customers adapt to new systems and a refreshed approach.

-
Best Practices & Recommendations: You take pride in advising customers on best practices specific to their usage of software to ensure optimal value.

-
Critical Thinking & Solutions Orientation: You proactively address thematic customer opportunities and improve our processes accordingly. You don’t rely on ‘I’ve seen this done,’ but instead think critically to solve problems.

-
Cross-functional Collaboration: You effectively partner with cross-functional stakeholders across Customer Success, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Operations to align and define progress.

You could be a great fit if:

-
📣 You demonstrate clear communication. You ask clarifying questions with precision and can distill complex concepts into simple themes.

-
🎧 You are a great listener. You see your role as the voice of the customer to internal stakeholders so we can ensure that our offerings continue to evolve in accordance with customer needs.

-
📈 You are a problem solver. You thrive at solving complex challenges with innovative, scalable solutions.

-
⚡️You know process matters. You are eager to improve processes and workflows to enhance efficiency and efficacy.

-
🔍 Your peers describe you as detail-oriented and technically proficient. You take pride in internal operations.

-
📊 You are data-driven. You use metrics and analytics to inform decisions and measure success.

-
🌍 You are adaptable. You can navigate changes in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

-
🧑‍🏫 You love to coach. You see every teaching moment as an opportunity and are excited to help our customers grow.

You might not be a great fit if:

-
You bring project management expertise, but rely on other resources to be technical or product subject matter experts during implementations.

-
You prefer managing shorter implementations of less than 30 days.

-
You typically manage only a few simultaneous implementations at a time - This segment moves with urgency and we balance a book of business of about 15 implementations at a time

-
You are accustomed to defining ideas and strategies, yet not responsible for their execution.

-
You prefer working with a simple product (such as a point solution).

-
You prefer exclusively to build (rather than build, iterate, optimize).

Our Philosophy

Here are a few key points (relevant to the go-to-market side) that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

-
We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is a lot easier to sell.

-
We want to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.

-
We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people (and the right work environment) deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount. We hire and compensate accordingly.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Operating Principles to get a sense of what we are looking for in folks on the team.

The Interview

At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. Our interview process is structured to get to know you and your career as well as empower you with insight into our key focus areas. Here is the process in its entirety:

-
30 min - Recruiter Screen with Talent Team

-
45 min - Interview with Manager of High Touch Implementations

-
60 min- Mock Call with Strategic Implementation Specialist and High Touch Implementation Specialist

-
Final Round:

-
30 min - Cross-Functional Interview with Head of Professional Services

-
30 min - Product Complexity Interview with VP of Customer Success

-
30 min - Customer Adoption & Enablement with Manager of High Touch Customer Success and a High Touch Customer Success Manager

-
10 min - Closing Questions with Hiring Manager

Benefits

-
You’ll get the time to do things the right way; we put a lot of emphasis on high quality work and avoid quick hacks as much as possible.

-
You get to sell a product that our prospects & customers are truly excited about.

-
Competitive compensation is offered.

-
10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

-
Unlimited PTO with four weeks is recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

-
Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

-
Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

-
$100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

jobs.description:
Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.

At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.

If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

How You’ll Make an Impact

As a Customer & Technical Support Specialist at Nextiva, you’ll be on the front lines of delivering exceptional customer experiences. You’re not just solving issues, you’re uncovering the “why,” guiding customers to the right solutions, and making their day easier.

As a Technical Support Representative, you will deliver Amazing Service® through high-quality technical support services by processing and resolving requests received across various communication channels; while continuously growing your skills in a fast-paced, learning environment. You’ll leverage modern tools, including AI, to work smarter, move faster, and deliver even better outcomes for customers.

What You’ll Do

- Solve What Matters: Troubleshoot customer issues across hardware, software, and networking systems, quickly identifying root causes and driving resolution

- Deliver Great Experiences: Communicate clearly and professionally to ensure every interaction is positive and productive

- Stay on the Details: Document customer interactions, issues, and resolutions with accuracy and consistency

- Keep Systems Running: Provide, maintain, and update systems to ensure optimal performance for customers; managing multiple requests simultaneously in a fast-paced, high-volume environment

- Own the Outcome: Take full ownership of customer issues, following through until resolution while meeting daily and monthly performance metrics

- Continuous Learning: Continuously build technical knowledge of Nextiva products, systems, and troubleshooting processes to provide better service. Explore new tools and ways of working to improve performance

- Work Smarter:

- Leverage AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to support daily workflows, such as summarizing customer interactions, identifying key action items, and improving response quality

- Apply clear and structured inputs when using AI tools to generate accurate and relevant outputs; iterating and refining your approach when the responses aren't perfect (persistence is key!)

About You:

- 2+ years of customer service experience, preferably in technical support or help desk environment

- Working knowledge of PC and Mac operating systems and Microsoft Office applications; hardware and/or networking knowledge preferred

- Advanced English fluency required (spoken and written).

- Ability to work remotely in Ukraine and regularly work shifts aligned with US business hours (between 12:00pm-4:00am Monday through Friday)

- Curiosity and enthusiasm for learning new technologies

- Comfort working in fast-paced environments with evolving tools and processes

Core Competencies:

- Customer First: Patient, conscientious and professional; providing great customer experiences with a focus on accuracy

- Problem Solver: Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with a persistent, solution-oriented mindset; able to overcome setbacks and willing to try multiple paths to reach the right solution

- Detail-Oriented: Ability to manage multiple tasks or conversations simultaneously; strong attention to detail in both technical work and documentation

- AI-Forward Mindset: Curiosity and willingness to experiment with AI & automation tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot); exposure to similar tools in a professional environment preferred

- Team-Driven: You collaborate, share knowledge, and contribute to a positive team environment

Why Nextiva?

- Impact: Join a company trusted by over a million users, helping businesses deliver better customer experiences every day

- Innovation: Be part of a team building AI-powered solutions that drive efficiency and smarter customer engagement

- Growth: Thrive in a culture focused on continuous learning, development, and career progression

- Culture: Work alongside a supportive, high-energy team committed to Amazing Service® and meaningful connections

Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies)

Nextiva’s most successful team members share common traits and behaviors:

- Drives Results: Action-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go.

- Critical Thinker: Data-driven, forward-thinking individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision-making, and focus on higher-value work.

- Right Attitude: Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and care for customers and teammates.

Total Rewards

Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow Nexties to take care of themselves and their families so they can do their best.

Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary, incentives, or bonuses.

- Health 🍏 – Comprehensive medical coverage, individual limit on exclusions and dental care

- Insurance 💼– Life, disability, traumatic injuries and critical diseases

- Work-Life Balance ⚖️ – PTO for all employees, Paid Sick leave (official document required), paid parental leave and paid holidays

- Wellness 🤸‍ – Employee Assistance Program and wellness initiatives

- Growth 🌱 – Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and career advancement

At Nextiva, we're committed to supporting our employees' health, well-being, and professional growth. Join us and build a rewarding career!

#LI-AL1 #LI-Remote

Founded in 2008, Nextiva has grown into a global leader trusted by over 100,000 businesses and 1M+ users worldwide. Headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, and with teams across the globe, we're the future of customer experience and team collaboration through our AI-powered, conversation-centric platform.

Want to see what life at Nextiva is all about? Connect with us on Instagram, Instagram MX, YouTube, LinkedIn, and the Nextiva Blog.

jobs.title: Order Processing Tech Support Specialist
jobs.summary: Company Overview LevelUp is a specialist agency that provides outsourcing solutions to agencies, software vendors, and website owners.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

LevelUp is a specialist agency that provides outsourcing solutions to agencies, software vendors, and website owners. For over seven years, we have successfully collaborated with a variety of companies, providing valuable technical, operational, and back-office support. We boast a large team of skilled and passionate professionals who are committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients.

Position Overview

We're looking for an Order Processing Tech Support Specialist to join our support team. This role is the first point of contact for the sales team when they hit issues in Salesforce, covering day-to-day order troubleshooting. We want someone with a keen eye for detail who can pinpoint the errors and misconfigurations, who genuinely enjoys solving problems, communicates clearly and comfortably, and takes pride in making sure the sales team feels supported.

Reference: 2631-407585

Responsibilities

- Serve as the first point of contact for the sales team in troubleshooting order issues in Salesforce, over Slack and Zendesk

- Identify what's blocking an order or opportunity, whether a validation error, an incorrect field value, or a wrong selection, and advise the user on resolving the error

- Investigate orders that fail at the point of processing, reproducing the issue where possible and isolating the cause before escalating

- Document resolutions, tag tickets correctly, and contribute to the internal knowledge base so recurring issues are faster to resolve next time

Requirements (Must-haves)

- Salesforce Sales Cloud Experience: Hands-on experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud, including opportunities, accounts, quotes, orders, and pipeline stages.

- 2–3 Years Technical Customer Support: Proven track record supporting users in real-time via live chat (Slack, Zendesk, or similar platforms).

- Problem-Solving Skills: Demonstrated experience troubleshooting order processing issues, such as validation errors and user error

- Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English skills to translate complex technical fixes to non-technical teams.

Nice-to-haves

- Working knowledge of NetSuite as an ERP system

- Experience in order management, order processing, or sales operations support, or equivalent hands-on experience working with sales orders

- Hands-on experience with SQL, BigQuery, or data reporting tools.

- Familiarity with Jira for issue tracking, escalation, and ticket management.

- Experience working for a hosting or a B2B SaaS company.

More Information:

- This is a fully remote position with a standard 40-hour fixed-schedule work week.

- This is shifting schedule. The exact work schedule depends on the client that you are assigned to but is often an afternoon or night schedule and so having flexibility when it comes to schedule is important.

- We have a company culture that focuses on the well-being of its team members, with a good work life balance and respectful work environment.

- This role follows the US Central Time

- Equipment provided

- HMO + 13th month pay

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Melbourne, Victoria, Australia

URL: https://instantscripts.com.au

Company Description

At InstantScripts, we believe healthcare should be accessible, flexible, and driven by excellence. As Australia's leading online medical services provider, we are reshaping how patients access care, and that starts with building an exceptional clinical workforce.
Join us in "Pioneering for Better" and be part of a movement that values your expertise, respects your time, and connects you to a like-minded community committed to making healthcare more human, accessible, and exceptional.

Job Description

InstantScripts is seeking an experienced Recruitment Specialist to join our Workforce Planning and Operations team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment process to attract, source, and secure top talent that aligns with the InstantScripts Telehealth business needs, values, and culture. This role works closely with hiring managers and InstantScripts leadership team to develop workforce attraction strategies, build strong candidate pipelines, and ensure a positive candidate experience.
Working under the direction of the Workforce Planning and Operations Manager and in support of the Doctor Recruitment team, you will manage assigned recruitment and engagement activities within approved processes.
What you'll do:
- Manage the end-to-end recruitment process, including job advertising, candidate sourcing, screening, interviewing, reference checks, and offer management.
- Develop and maintain strong talent pipelines through proactive sourcing, networking, and engagement strategies.
- Utilise applicant tracking systems (ATS) and other recruitment tools to manage candidate flow and ensure compliance with recruitment processes
- Assist with onboarding processes as required, to ensure smooth transitions for new hires.
- Follow up on onboarding, technology and engagement concerns to strengthen early retention, escalating performance, clinical and sensitive matters appropriately.
- Support attraction activity including job advertising, talent pools, referrals, information sessions, careers events and newsletters, and contribute practical improvements to candidate experience, scheduling and systems.
What we offer?
- Competitive salary plus superannuation
- Structured onboarding and ongoing support within a collaborative Workforce Operations team

Qualifications

We're looking for someone with:
- Strong relationship management skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers
- Exceptional communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across business units
- The ability to work independently, prioritise and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
- Proven experience in end-to-end recruitment experience, preferably within healthcare environment (minimum 5 years' experience)
- Strong knowledge of sourcing strategies, recruitment systems, and employment legislation
- A proactive, results-driven and adaptable approach to changing business needs
You will bring proven end-to-end recruitment experience, ideally within a healthcare environment, across a variety of role types and levels. You will have strong knowledge of sourcing strategies, recruitment systems and employment legislation, and a relevant tertiary qualification in Human Resources, Business or a related field is desirable.

Additional Information

InstantScripts, wholly owned by Wesfarmers, is more than a platform. It's where your work meets purpose. If you're passionate about digital healthcare, thrive on building great candidate and workforce experiences, and are ready to join a network of forward-thinking professionals, we want to hear from you.
Apply with your CV and a short cover letter outlining your recruitment experience.

- Role Title: Candidate Manager
- Employment Type: Fixed Term Contract
- Services: General Practice
- Job Location: Remote
- Compensation: AUD 95000 - AUD 100000 - yearly

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/instantscripts-gp-recruitment-specialist-full-time

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines

URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b

Position: Bookkeeper & Admin Support Specialist
Salary: Php 60,000 - Php 75,000/month
Working Hours & Conditions: AU Working Hours and Holidays
Employment: Full Time - Independent Contractor

ABOUT THE COMPANY:
The company is a well-established family business based in Perth, WA, with over 15 years of experience manufacturing high-quality bird seed, poultry feed, and small animal mixes, alongside a comprehensive range of pet, garden, and farm products. The company operates as part of a group of three related business entities spanning retail, manufacturing, wholesale, and gardening supplies. Together, these entities are committed to quality products, reliable service, and strong community relationships.

ROLE OVERVIEW:
We are seeking a dedicated, highly reliable, and detail-oriented Bookkeeper & Admin Support Specialist to manage day-to-day financial operations across three related entities. This role is designed for a self-motivated professional who takes true ownership of their work. Pure bookkeeping responsibilities are estimated to cover roughly three days per week or more. As accuracy, trust, and operational familiarity build, the role will naturally expand into executive assistance, customer communications, and general administrative support, scaling into a comprehensive, full-time position.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Core Bookkeeping
- Perform regular bank reconciliations across all three business entities.
- Manage invoicing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and statement reconciliations.
- Process payroll accurately, efficiently, and on time.
- Prepare and lodge Business Activity Statements (BAS) in compliance with Australian tax standards.

Manufacturing & Inventory Operations
- Manage inventory builds, cost of goods tracking, and inventory-related invoicing specifically for the manufacturing and wholesale operations at the company.

Administrative & Executive Assistant Growth
- Manage incoming emails and handle direct customer communications as the scope expands.
- Provide general back-end administrative support across all three business entities.
- Partner with the business owner to dynamically shape and expand administrative processes as trust and operational rhythm develop.

- Software Proficiency: Hands-on, demonstrated expertise in both Xero and MYOB (live capability demonstration required during the initial interview phase).
- Bookkeeping Mastery: Extensive experience in bank reconciliations, invoicing, statement reconciliations, payroll processing, and BAS preparation/lodgment.
- Autonomy & Ownership: Ability to independently manage the books with minimal oversight, proactively flagging discrepancies and resolving issues.
- Dependability: A proven track record of exceptional accuracy, reliable attendance, and strong attention to detail.

Preferred
- Prior experience with manufacturing/inventory bookkeeping (e.g., stock builds, assembly/COGS tracking, wholesale billing).
- Demonstrated experience or strong enthusiasm for expanding into EA/VA roles, including inbox management and client correspondence.
- Proven track record of concurrently managing accounts for multiple related business entities.

What You’ll Bring
- Uncompromising Integrity & Reliability: High personal accountability and absolute dependability, delivering accuracy every single time.
- Proactive Problem-Solving: A sharp eye for detail that catches errors before they become issues and takes initiative to keep systems running smoothly.
- Clear Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication style suitable for direct customer service and clear internal collaboration.
- Adaptability & Growth Mindset: Comfort in stepping beyond traditional bookkeeping to take on broader administrative tasks as the role evolves.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-bookkeeper-admin-support-specialist-dayshift-remote

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Taguig, Metro Manila, Philippines

URL: http://getmagic.com

Client Account Specialist
Department: Support
Employment Type: Full Time
Location: Philippines
Reporting To: Andrea Santisteban
Compensation: ₱38,000 / month

Description
For over 10 years, Magic has connected top remote talent with fast-growing businesses — backed by Y Combinator and Sequoia Capital, with thousands of remote workers worldwide.

When a business brings on a Magic assistant, the relationship doesn't run itself. That's where you come in.

This is a post-sale, account-first role. You'll carry a book of client-assistant pairings and be accountable for how well each one works — from day one of onboarding through every milestone after. Inbound requests will come in, but fielding requests isn't the core of the job. The core is knowing your accounts well enough that you can spot what's about to go wrong before it does, get on a call, and fix it.

Shift: Monday–Friday, 10 PM–7 AM PHT. Training runs 4 weeks across two phases — Product & Skills (shadowing, live-call listening) then Immersion (live tickets and onboarding under supervision, KPIs measured from day one). Zero absences during training, documented medical emergencies only, 80%+ required on daily assessments and mock calls to continue.

Key Responsibilities

-
Manage a portfolio of client accounts — track the health of each pairing, flag risks early, and keep every relationship on track

-
Lead onboarding sessions, 30-day account reviews, and recurring check-ins that keep clients and their assistants aligned

-
Advocate for assistants internally — coaching conversations, feedback loops, and surfacing what they need to leadership

-
Own retention conversations — identify accounts at risk and lead win-back efforts before the client decides to leave

-
Handle 30+ inbound account requests daily with fast, personalized responses that reflect actual knowledge of that account

-
Maintain clean, detailed HubSpot records for every client interaction — useful to anyone who touches the account after you

-
Coordinate across Operations, Finance, and Engineering when an account issue goes beyond your direct scope

Qualifications & Technical Requirements

- 3+ years of client-facing experience in account management, account support, or B2B customer success — US accounts strongly preferred

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple active client accounts simultaneously without losing thread or detail

- Fluent written and verbal English — equally sharp in a written account update and a live escalation call

- Reliable night-shift availability (10 PM–7 AM PHT) with documented history of night-shift work

- CRM proficiency, HubSpot preferred

- Proactive by default — you identify account risks and act on them before anyone has to ask

After 90 days, your accounts run smoothly not because nothing went wrong — but because you caught the problems early and handled them. You know your client portfolio without having to look everything up. You're as comfortable on a direct call with a frustrated client as you are writing a clear, concise account note at 3 AM. You've worked night shift before, and you know how to pace yourself through a shift that gets busy fast when US business hours kick in.
This isn't the role if you've never managed a real account portfolio before, if "account ownership" means something different to you than being personally responsible for how each relationship turns out, or if your default is to wait for issues to escalate before you move.

Application + Pre-Qualifying Questions → HR Interview (30 min) → Skill Assessment (Written Case Study) → Second-Level Interview with Support Management → Mock Feedback Call → Final Interview with Head of Sales → Job Offer → 4-Week Training Program

Compensation & Benefits
Gross package ₱32,000–₱38,000/month, total potential ₱38,000–₱40,000/month · Night shift (10 PM–7 AM PHT) · Full training program included
We're ambitious, driven, and unapologetically the type to plow through obstacles instead of waiting for perfect conditions. Our work dynamic is genuinely different — dynamic, friendly conversations, zero politics, and no hierarchy standing in your way. You can talk to anyone, on any team, about anything, because we respect each other's time and actually like working together. Y Combinator and Sequoia-backed, thousands of remote workers strong, and growing.

About the CompanyThe client is a New Zealand-based wellness brand specialising in nutritional supplements and wellness products. The company is committed to developing high-quality, science-led products that support everyday health and wellbeing. With a growing presence across New Zealand and Australia, they continue to expand its e-commerce, wholesale, and retail operations while maintaining a strong focus on product quality and customer experience.
About the RoleWe are looking for a highly organised and proactive E-commerce & Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of a growing wellness brand across New Zealand and Australia.
This is a broad, hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working across multiple areas of a business, including e-commerce, customer experience, wholesale account management, supply chain, inventory coordination, and project administration.
Working closely with the Head of Operations, you will play an important role in keeping business operations running smoothly, coordinating with customers, retailers, suppliers, manufacturers, and logistics partners, and ensuring that operational processes, documentation, and reporting are maintained accurately.
The ideal candidate is commercially minded, detail-oriented, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of tasks in a fast-paced, growing business.
Key Responsibilities1. E-commerce & Customer Experience
- Manage customer enquiries across email, live chat, helpdesk, website, and social media channels.
- Oversee online order processing, tracking, amendments, cancellations, refunds, returns, and subscription changes.
- Coordinate with couriers and third-party logistics (3PL) providers to resolve delivery issues and fulfilment discrepancies.
- Monitor customer feedback, identify recurring issues, and prepare monthly customer insights reports.
2. Brand & Influencer Coordination
- Manage day-to-day communications across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, following established brand guidelines.
- Coordinate influencer and UGC creator outreach, applications, product gifting, campaign timelines, and deliveries.
- Maintain creator databases, campaign trackers, usage rights, posting schedules, and partnership documentation.
- Support PR activities, brand collaborations, and monthly influencer reporting.
3. Wholesale & Retail Operations
- Coordinate new wholesale account enquiries, onboarding, and ongoing retailer relationships.
- Process wholesale orders, confirmations, and invoicing using Unleashed.
- Maintain wholesale pricing, product information, retailer documentation, and promotional materials.
- Coordinate with distributors, retail partners, warehouses, and logistics providers to ensure timely order fulfilment.
- Support wholesale reporting, sales performance tracking, and retailer re-order activities.
4. Supply Chain & Inventory Coordination
- Assist with production scheduling, purchase orders, supplier follow-ups, and import/export logistics.
- Monitor stock levels, inventory movements, batch tracking, expiry dates, and warehouse accuracy.
- Liaise with manufacturers, suppliers, freight providers, and 3PL partners across New Zealand and Australia.
- Track production timelines, warehouse transfers, delivery documentation, and supplier milestones.
- Support demand forecasting, inventory reporting, and monthly supply and operations planning.
5. Project & Business Operations
- Coordinate new product development activities, including product documentation, specifications, costing records, and production timelines.
- Support product launches, packaging readiness, and operational project administration.
- Maintain operational trackers, master data, dashboards, SOPs, and shared documentation.
- Assist with business-wide projects, process improvements, system integration, and operational reporting.
- Provide regular progress updates and administrative support to the Head of Operations.

- 3+ years of experience in operations coordination, e-commerce operations, supply chain, or a similar role.
- Experience in supplements, nutraceuticals, health and wellness, food and beverage, or FMCG industries is highly desirable.
- Hands-on experience with Shopify, including order management, customer service, subscriptions, and e-commerce reporting.
- Background in wholesale/B2B operations, account management, order processing, invoicing, and retailer coordination.
- Knowledge of inventory management, stock forecasting, purchase orders, supplier coordination, and warehouse fulfilment.
- Familiarity with inventory management or ERP systems, particularly Unleashed, is an advantage.
- Excellent organisational, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
What We're Looking ForWe are particularly interested in candidates who have worked in growing consumer brands, especially within the wellness, supplements, food and beverage, or FMCG industries.
You don't necessarily need experience in every area of the role, but you should bring a strong foundation in e-commerce and business operations, with the versatility to support different functions and take ownership of day-to-day responsibilities.
If you're someone who enjoys bringing structure to operations, solving problems, coordinating people and processes, and contributing to the growth of a dynamic business, we'd love to hear from you.

- Remote / WFH

Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

Motive is seeking a skilled installer to join our team. As an Installation Specialist, you will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of telematics devices within customer vehicles, ensuring high-quality workmanship and customer satisfaction. This role offers a unique mix of hands-on technical work, customer interaction, and strategic project management, perfect for those passionate about technology's role in operational improvement.

jobs.title: Workplace Operations Coordinator
jobs.summary: Chi siamo Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte.
jobs.description:
Chi siamo 
Il sistema energetico funziona meglio quando le persone possono farne parte. In Octopus Energy lo facciamo già ogni giorno: rendiamo l'energia più equa e accessibile grazie alla tecnologia.
Presenti in Italia dal 2022, siamo partiti da Ascoli Piceno, dove abbiamo la nostra sede. Oggi abbiamo superato un milione di utenze, con un team di oltre 300 persone tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma, e più di 250 milioni di euro investiti nel Paese. Una crescita nata da un modo diverso di fare energia: più semplice, più umano, più tecnologico.
 
Come lavoriamo 
Non siamo una compagnia tradizionale e non vogliamo diventarlo. Non ci piacciono la burocrazia, le procedure inutili o i reparti che si scaricano i problemi a vicenda. Quando un cliente ha bisogno di aiuto, vogliamo che trovi persone capaci di ascoltare, prendersi la responsabilità e risolvere.
Questo approccio ci ha portati a essere valutati 4,9/5 su Trustpilot, a vincere la classifica Altroconsumo e a ricevere il premio "Miglior Servizio Clienti" del Corriere della Sera.
 
La tecnologia al servizio di tutti
Qui la tecnologia non è riservata a pochi esperti: è uno strumento che aiuta tutti a lavorare meglio. Non serve essere un mago del computer, ma serve curiosità. Usiamo dati, automazione e intelligenza artificiale per togliere complessità, capire meglio i problemi e dedicare più energia a ciò che conta: migliorare il modo in cui le persone vivono l’energia.
 
Cosa troverai in Octopus
Octopus è un posto per chi vuole portare energia e buon senso. I problemi non arrivano sempre ordinati, le risposte non sono sempre già scritte e spesso c’è da costruire mentre si corre. Ma non sarai solo: lavorerai con persone curiose, generose e concrete, che si aiutano a vicenda e vogliono lasciare le cose meglio di come le hanno trovate. Stiamo già migliorando il modo in cui l’energia funziona per le persone: se vuoi prenderti responsabilità e contribuire a questo cambiamento, qui il tuo lavoro può avere un impatto vero.
 

Gli spazi in cui lavoriamo contano: sono il posto dove le persone si incontrano, si aiutano e costruiscono Octopus ogni giorno. E in Italia stiamo crescendo in fretta, tra Ascoli Piceno, Milano e Roma.

Cerchiamo una persona che si prenda la responsabilità di tutti i nostri spazi fisici, con una visione d’insieme: dove abbiamo sede, a quali condizioni, con quali fornitori, se rispettiamo le norme e come cresceremo. La gestione quotidiana degli uffici è ad oggi affidata agli Office Manager, e tu li guidi e li metti nelle condizioni di lavorare bene, senza sostituirti a loro.

Non cerchiamo un facility manager e nemmeno qualcuno che aggiunga procedure. Cerchiamo una persona che tratti i nostri spazi come se fossero casa sua: con cura, con attenzione a come si spendono i soldi, e con la libertà di decidere da sola ciò che serve, senza aspettare che qualcuno lo chieda. Qualcuno con iniziativa, buonsenso e un approccio commerciale, che renda i nostri spazi semplici da vivere e sostenibili nel tempo.

-
Guida degli Office Manager: dare indirizzo e supporto agli Office Manager delle nostre sedi, definire insieme standard comuni, e fare da riferimento quando un problema supera l’operatività quotidiana.

-
Strategia degli spazi e nuove sedi: guidare la ricerca di nuove sedi e coordinare allestimenti, trasferimenti e apertura dei nuovi spazi, dal progetto alla consegna, definendo come i nostri uffici devono crescere insieme all’azienda.

-
Contratti di locazione e proprietà: gestire i contratti esistenti, le scadenze e i rinnovi, e condurre le trattative su nuovi immobili e condizioni.

-
Contratti con i fornitori: negoziare, rivedere e armonizzare i contratti quadro (pulizie, manutenzioni, utenze, sicurezza, servizi generali), cercando efficienze e sinergie tra le sedi dove ha senso.

-
Spedizioni e corrieri: governare il processo di spedizioni e posta e gestire il rapporto con il fornitore di corriere, definendo regole, livelli di servizio e costi.

-
Presidio degli asset aziendali: assicurare che gli asset di Octopus, come il magazzino e i mezzi aziendali, siano gestiti con cura (inventario, accessi, sicurezza, assicurazioni).

-
Lavorare con tutta l’azienda: collaborare con i colleghi e i responsabili delle diverse aree per far funzionare gli spazi in modo coordinato.

-
Portare avanti la missione di Octopus: fare tua la missione e l’indirizzo dell’azienda, tradurli nelle scelte sugli spazi e portarli avanti con convinzione, facendoli rispettare. Non tutto avrà una procedura già pronta: ti muovi anche dove le cose non sono definite e trovi la soluzione sensata

-
Orientamento alla soluzione e concretezza: non hai paura di metterti in gioco in prima persona, ti piace l'operatività e trovi soddisfazione nel risolvere i problemi sul campo in modo rapido e pratico.

-
Esperienza: hai avuto esperienza in contesti operativi, di accoglienza, retail, hospitality o supporto organizzativo, ma soprattutto hai una gran voglia di imparare e crescere in un contesto veloce.

-
Energia e spirito di iniziativa: sei una persona dinamica, solare e positiva. Se c'è da spostare uno scatolone, riordinare una sala o gestire un'emergenza dell'ultimo minuto, sei il* prim* a dare una mano.

-
Precisione e doti organizzative: anche nel caos saprai prioritizzare le urgenze e tenere tutto sotto controllo senza perdere il filo.

-
Condivisione della missione: senti tua la direzione dell’azienda, la traduci in decisioni concrete e la porti avanti con convinzione, facendola rispettare.

-
Comfort con il non strutturato: ti trovi a tuo agio dove non tutto è definito da procedure e sai costruire l’ordine man mano.

In Octopus fare bene il tuo lavoro è naturale: trovi le condizioni giuste per esprimerti al meglio, perché i tuoi obiettivi, quelli dei colleghi e quelli dell’azienda sono perfettamente allineati.

Lavorerai con persone curiose, brillanti e concrete, che hanno voglia di fare bene e migliorare davvero le cose.

Lavorerai per un’azienda che le persone scelgono perché si fidano: abbiamo un servizio clienti valutato 4,9/5 su Trustpilot e premiato da Altroconsumo e dal Corriere della Sera.

Farai parte di una realtà concreta, veloce e poco burocratica, dove contano i risultati, il modo in cui li raggiungiamo e l’impatto che creiamo per i clienti.

- Octopus Energy è un luogo in cui le persone hanno spazio per imparare, prendersi responsabilità e fare davvero la differenza.

-
Equity Options Scheme: in Octopus puoi avere accesso a opzioni su azioni del Gruppo. In pratica, puoi possedere la tua parte di Octopus Energy e partecipare al valore che costruiamo insieme.

-
Focus sul tuo benessere: ti supportiamo con vantaggi concreti come i buoni pasto e un accesso gratuito a sessioni di benessere psicologico.

-
Cultura: ogni settimana, il venerdì, ci riuniamo tutti per gli aggiornamenti aziendali e un brindisi. Lo chiamiamo Family Dinner.

-
Sede: Ancarano (TE)

-
Ore: Tempo pieno

-
Presenza in ufficio: Si

Da 37K

La normativa ci chiede di indicare la retribuzione di partenza, e ci sembra giusto farlo. Allo stesso tempo, non amiamo la burocrazia né crediamo che il valore di una persona possa essere racchiuso in una tabella. Preferiamo usare il buonsenso: l'eventuale offerta sarà costruita sulla base delle valutazioni fatte durante il percorso di selezione, tenendo conto di esperienza, competenze, luogo di lavoro e allineamento con il ruolo e con ciò che stiamo costruendo.

jobs.title: Data Security Specialist
jobs.summary: Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time: Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina.
jobs.description:
Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time:

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário:

O Data Security Specialist é um profissional técnico responsável pela execução e operação dos controles de segurança de dados corporativos e de produção do iFood. Essa posição atua na interseção entre engenharia de segurança, proteção de dados e execução técnica — implementando controles, investigando incidentes e operando as ferramentas que protegem os ativos de dados do iFood.
O Data Security Specialist executa as operações de segurança de dados, impulsiona a adoção de AI nos fluxos de trabalho diários de segurança e garante que as capacidades de proteção de dados acompanhem o crescimento do iFood. É uma posição de contribuidor individual que exige experiência prática comprovada em engenharia de segurança de dados, com capacidade de atuar tanto no ambiente corporativo quanto no de produção.

Segurança de Dados Corporativos

- Operar e evoluir os controles de DLP (Data Loss Prevention) e ZTNA (Zero Trust Network Access) para endpoints, aplicações em cloud e canais de comunicação — implementando políticas, ajustando regras e executando as prioridades trimestrais.

- Implementar e fazer cumprir políticas de classificação de dados e procedimentos de tratamento para usuários internos e terceiros, garantindo alinhamento com LGPD, GDPR e requisitos regulatórios (BACEN, PCI-DSS, entre outros).

- Configurar e manter os controles de segurança para plataformas corporativas de SaaS: Databricks, Salesforce, Google Workspace, outras plataformas e ferramentas emergentes baseadas em AI — estabelecendo baselines de hardening, controles de acesso e governança de configuração.

- Implementar e fazer cumprir políticas de Document Retention & Disposal — estabelecendo cronogramas de retenção, procedimentos de descarte e mecanismos automatizados de aplicação.

- Executar o programa de insider threat: ajustar regras de behavioral analytics, conduzir cadências de análise de anomalias e coordenar com HR e Legal os casos de risco elevado.

- Gerenciar políticas de device posture e a aplicação de ZTNA, garantindo o acesso de dispositivos em conformidade em todo o ambiente corporativo.

Segurança de Dados de Produção

- Conduzir revisões de segurança da arquitetura de dados de produção: avaliar integrações de dados entre sistemas internos, parceiros e clientes, identificando riscos em APIs, pipelines de ETL e padrões de transferência de arquivos.

- Executar o workstream de Data Security no processo de Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), atuando de forma cross-functional com a equipe de IT Risk e contribuindo continuamente para a melhoria dos security review gates, dos requisitos contratuais de segurança e do monitoramento contínuo dos arranjos de troca de dados com terceiros.

- Promover security-by-design nas equipes de engenharia e dados: incorporar requisitos de proteção de dados aos padrões de desenho de integrações, aos frameworks de governança de APIs e aos controles de data residency.

- Garantir que data residency, criptografia em trânsito e em repouso e modelos de controle de acesso atendam às obrigações regulatórias e contratuais em todos os ambientes de produção.

- Apoiar os programas de conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR, PCI-DSS) relacionados à proteção de dados, atuando como ponto de contato técnico de Data Security para as equipes de Legal, Compliance e Audit.

Adoção de AI e Resultados Mensuráveis

- Impulsionar a adoção de AI nos fluxos de trabalho de Data Security: implementar ferramentas de AI para detecção de padrões anômalos de dados, classificação automatizada de dados, ajuste de políticas de DLP e aceleração de investigações — com melhorias mensuráveis na velocidade de detecção, na redução de falsos positivos e na produtividade dos analistas.

- Contribuir para o workstream de Data Security para AI Security, atuando de forma cross-functional com a equipe de AI Security para melhorar continuamente a governança e definir requisitos de proteção de dados para ferramentas de AI, incluindo casos de uso aprovados, tratamento de dados sensíveis em prompts, controles de acesso, monitoramento e padrões de adoção.

- Acompanhar e reportar os resultados impulsionados por AI: quantificar o tempo economizado, os riscos detectados mais cedo e as melhorias na precisão da classificação atribuíveis às ferramentas de AI.

Colaboração Cross-functional e Resposta a Incidentes

- Atuar como referência técnica de Data Security para as equipes adjacentes: traduzir cenários complexos de riscos relacionados a dados em atualizações claras e contextualizadas pelo impacto no negócio para o Data Security Manager e para os times de segurança.

- Construir e manter o dashboard operacional de Data Security: tendências de risco, taxas de violações de políticas, SLAs de remediação, métricas de adoção de AI e status operacional.

- Participar de iniciativas cross-functional de Data Security: coordenar com Legal, Product, Engineering e IT para equilibrar requisitos de segurança e velocidade do negócio — encontrando o caminho seguro que viabilize a entrega de produtos.

- Gerenciar solicitações de exceção de Data Security: avaliar exceções baseadas em risco às políticas de segurança, documentar recomendações e acompanhar o ciclo de vida das exceções.

- Atuar na resposta a incidentes como referência técnica de Data Security: conduzir a frente de investigação específica de dados durante incidentes de grande impacto, coordenar com o CSIRT e comunicar o impacto do risco relacionado a dados ao Data Security Manager.

Operação Técnica de Programas

- Executar o roadmap técnico de Data Security: traduzir as metas estratégicas em tarefas operacionais, gerenciar o acompanhamento de dependências e reportar o progresso ao Data Security Manager.

- Conduzir iniciativas de Sensitive Data Mapping: executar a descoberta, classificação e catalogação cross-functional de dados nos ambientes corporativos e de produção.

- Construir e manter métricas de Data Security: índices de exposição a riscos, tendências de violações de políticas, taxas de encerramento de alertas de DLP, SLAs de remediação e velocidade operacional.

- Documentar e manter runbooks, playbooks e procedimentos operacionais padrão para as operações de Data Security.

Ingredientes Que Buscamos:

- Experiência comprovada como Data Security Specialist, Analyst ou Engineer — com histórico de responsabilidade técnica por um domínio de Data Security.

- Sólida compreensão dos princípios de arquitetura Zero Trust e de sua implementação prática: ZTNA, conditional access, device posture e identity-based segmentation.

- Conhecimento profundo de hardening de segurança de SaaS corporativo: Google Workspace, Salesforce, Databricks, outras plataformas e plataformas emergentes baseadas em AI.

- Familiaridade com frameworks regulatórios: LGPD, GDPR, PCI-DSS e requisitos regulatórios do BACEN e do PROUF.

- Experiência prática com ferramentas de AI para Data Security: detecção de anomalias, classificação automatizada, ajuste de DLP ou aceleração de investigações — com resultados tangíveis e mensuráveis documentados.

- Capacidade de colaboração cross-functional: aptidão para conduzir resultados técnicos em colaboração com Legal, Engineering, Product e IT, equilibrando requisitos de segurança e velocidade do negócio.

- Habilidade de documentação e criação de runbooks, playbooks e procedimentos operacionais para Data Security.

- Inglês avançado (obrigatório).

Para Realçar o Sabor:

- Experiência com plataformas SASE (Netskope, Zscaler ou similares) e ferramentas de DSPM (Netskope, Cyera, Wiz ou similares).

- Experiência em data engineering ou analytics — compreensão dos fluxos de dados por dentro, incluindo arquitetura de pipelines, data warehousing e plataformas de dados em tempo real.

- Experiência na adoção de AI em Data Security: implementação de ferramentas de AI para operações de segurança, mensuração de ganhos de produtividade e iteração das estratégias de adoção.

- Certificações: CISM, CDPSE, CISSP ou equivalente.

- Experiência em um setor regulado (fintech, banking, payments, health tech), com exposição prática à conformidade regulatória.

Company Description

Palmetto is a consumer energy platform that provides homeowners with a single destination to discover, purchase, finance, install, monitor and manage home energy products and services. By offering one integrated platform across solar, battery storage, HVAC, heat pumps and more, Palmetto helps homeowners make home energy more affordable, reliable and accessible. Today Palmetto serves hundreds of thousands of homeowners, across 30+ states, building the operating infrastructure for the consumer energy transition, one home at a time.

Our employees are our most valuable resource. We foster a promote-from-within culture that prioritizes talent development, career growth, and purpose-driven work. Palmetto offers a comprehensive benefits package—including unlimited PTO, medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid parental leave, retirement plans, and more—so you can have it all both personally and professionally. Palmetto prioritizes people, planet, and profit—backed by a culture that values collaboration, impact, and balance. Join us in building a brighter, cleaner world.

Location

This position will be based remotely in the Philippines.

Reporting

This position will report to the Team Lead, Customer Success.

Summary of Role

As a Customer Success Specialist I, you will be the first point of contact for our solar customers. You’ll handle inbound calls, emails, and chats, providing clear answers, basic troubleshooting, and timely updates. Your focus will be on resolving common customer issues, delivering excellent service, and ensuring that every interaction leaves a positive impression.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys helping people, follows processes closely, and can effectively communicate technical information in simple terms. Tier 1 Specialists are critical to maintaining smooth operations, ensuring accurate documentation, and routing complex cases to the appropriate Tier 2 or escalation teams when necessary.

Strategic & Tactical

- Frontline Customer Support

- Handle inbound customer contacts (calls, emails, chats) regarding solar system performance, billing questions, and account support.

- Provide first-level troubleshooting and walk customers through basic steps to resolve issues.

- Accurately log and update all customer interactions in the CRM system.

- Set clear expectations on timelines and next steps.

- Issue Triage & Escalation

- Identify cases that require escalation to Tier 2 or specialized teams.

- Follow established SOPs for routing high-priority or technical cases.

- Gather and document all relevant details to ensure escalations are handled efficiently.

- Customer Experience & CSAT Focus

- Demonstrate empathy and professionalism in every interaction.

- Aim for first-contact resolution whenever possible.

- Proactively educate customers on how to monitor their solar system performance and where to find helpful resources.

- Process & Compliance

- Follow all SOPs for customer communication and data security.

- Adhere to service-level agreements (SLAs) for response times and resolution.

- Provide feedback to leadership on recurring issues, trends, or process gaps.

Qualifications

- 1+ year of customer service experience (call center or BPO preferred).

- Basic familiarity with solar energy systems or willingness to learn quickly.

- Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

- Ability to stay calm and professional under pressure.

- Comfortable using CRM/ticketing systems (Salesforce preferred but not required).

- Detail-oriented and able to follow SOPs accurately.

- A positive, team-oriented attitude and willingness to grow into more complex responsibilities.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish, with the ability to deliver constructive feedback clearly (required)

Success Defined

- First Contact Resolution (FCR) – Target: 80%+ of cases resolved without escalation.

- Average Handle Time (AHT) – 12 minutes

- CSAT Score – Target – 4+ customer satisfaction on post-contact surveys.

- Adherence to SOPs – 100% compliance on required processes and documentation.

jobs.description:
About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

About the team

The Internal Communications team exists to:

-
Drive alignment to the company vision and strategy, so every employee has a clear understanding of our priorities, why they're important, and how their work impacts our success

-
Build trust and connection, so employees are engaged as true advocates of the business; feel they have a clear voice and are listened to; and are equipped to deliver outstanding work through periods of transformational change, including the integration of Mollie and GoCardless

-
Scale and iterate on our fantastic culture, so the combination of Mollie and GoCardless creates an irresistible place to work, with a strong sense of belonging.

What excites you:

-
Help lead the day-to-day planning and output of the Internal Comms team; this includes ensuring we execute against projects, whilst keeping the momentum going with our continuous 'drumbeat' of regular communications

-
Develop communication plans to support the GoCardless and Mollie integration, helping colleagues across both businesses understand what's changing, why it matters, and what it means for them; building confidence as we come together

-
Be the primary owner of our Town Hall sessions, from shaping the agenda and briefing leaders and speakers to producing content, delivering the sessions and creating and sharing follow-up materials, so each one helps employees across the business understand where we're heading, and why

-
Devise and execute communication plans (for example, to roll out our engagement survey, business transformation, or to celebrate the launch of a new product) which deliver clear, measurable outcomes

-
Build connections to become a trusted adviser to stakeholders around the business to advise them on achieving their communications goals

-
Co-manage our communications channels, including our intranet, Slack, and email tool, and help shape how these channels continually develop and help us to show up across both GoCardless and Mollie

-
Host and measure regular listening sessions with employees from all of our locations, including colleagues joining us through Mollie, to help inform our work and identify opportunities for improvement and impact.

What excites us:

There's endless opportunity to have an impact in this role. The team sits at the heart of the business, helping to curate, contextualise, and build a shared understanding of the business' priorities, and the progress we're making. This is particularly important as we continue to integrate Mollie and GoCardless.

We distribute engaging company information and drive change via the right audiences, at the right time, using the most relevant channels. The integration is a huge opportunity for our team, meaning this is a demanding but very fulfilling time to join us. You should have demonstrable prior experience in internal communications at a fast-paced organisation where you've been able to prioritise effectively to deliver communications of a consistently high standard. You should be proactive, ultimately keeping your 'finger on the pulse' of the business to identify opportunities for internal comms to strengthen execution against our mission.

Specifically:

-
Experience in a busy internal communications team or function

-
Ability to originate and execute strategic internal communications plans; tactically deliver them; and measure results

-

jobs.description:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the Role

Working with Workplace customers (B2B) means being at the front line in our efforts to support healthcare facilities in delivering better care. The Workplace team is unified by our common goal: to represent our obsession with the customer experience through thoughtful action.

Clipboard is looking for highly motivated, customer-focused individuals to join our team as B2B Client Support Specialists (Workplace Support Agents).

This role is open to candidates of all experience levels—what matters most is your ability to handle business customers professionally and solve problems effectively. No specific degree required.

Success Factors

-
Customer-Centric Mindset – You genuinely care about helping customers and take ownership of their problems.

-
Strong Communication Skills – Clear, professional English (both spoken and written) is critical for success in this role.

-
Proactive Problem-Solving – You don’t just follow scripts—you think critically and find long-term solutions for customers.

-
High Accountability – We value people who hold themselves to high standards and consistently deliver results.

Responsibilities

-
You will engage with our Workplace customers over both voice and email correspondence.

-
Deliver fast, accurate, and empathetic support to our workplace customers across voice and email, resolving shift, payment, and platform-related issues in real time

-
Navigate tools like Zendesk and the Clipboard portal to investigate cases, update form fields, log clear internal notes, and maintain accurate documentation

-
Apply sound judgment and critical thinking to troubleshoot issues, follow or adapt workflows, and escalate only when necessary

-
Develop deep expertise in our products and processes to identify recurring issues or process gaps, helping improve both customer experiences and internal operations.

-
Work cross-functionally with teams such as Billing, Account Management, and Worker Operations to gather the necessary information and ensure customer issues are resolved effectively

-
Uphold our values such as unreasonably fast, ownership, and uncomfortably high standards in every interaction

Why Join Clipboard?

-
100% Remote – Always. Work from anywhere in the world.

-
Fast-Paced Startup Environment. Join a company that values curiosity, independence, and growth.

-
A Hiring Process That Rewards Skills, Not Just Experience. Every applicant gets a fair shot—our selection is based on real-world problem-solving ability, not just credentials.

-
Opportunity to make a significant impact with our workplace customers

Hiring Process

-
Application

-
Case Study

-
Interview with Hiring Manager

-
Executive Interview

-
Offer

Clipboard would never ask you for money or your bank details to participate in our hiring process. Report any scammers impersonating the Clipboard hiring team members here.

jobs.title: Paid Media Specialist - Argentina (Hybrid)
jobs.summary: Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation.
jobs.description:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

What you'll do

This is a highly hands-on Paid Media role. You will work directly inside the advertising platforms every day—building and launching campaigns, uploading creatives and copy, checking tracking, monitoring performance, and making optimizations.
This is not a strategy-only, coordination, or people-management position. We’re looking for someone who enjoys executing the work themselves and taking direct ownership of campaigns from setup through ongoing optimization.
You’ll manage campaigns across multiple platforms and markets while using AI as a core part of your workflow. You’ll be operating within one of Latin America’s fastest-growing companies, as ranked by the Financial Times, on a team that is actively building AI-native workflows into everything we do.
Your work will directly impact how Clara grows across Mexico, Brazil, and Colombia—and you’ll help define what AI-augmented Paid Media execution looks like at scale

Your responsibilities will include:

- Launch, monitor and quality assurance of campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other platforms.

- Set up tracking and attribution according to internal guidelines — including AI-assisted tagging validation and anomaly detection.

- Use AI tools daily to accelerate campaign work: generating ad copy variants, summarizing performance data, building audience hypotheses, and drafting creative briefs.

- Conduct keyword and audience research using both native platform tools and AI-powered research assistants (e.g. Claude, Perplexity, ChatGPT, custom GPTs).

- Support in A/B tests and make regular optimizations — using AI to generate hypotheses, interpret results, and suggest next steps.

- Build and maintain recurring performance reports, leveraging AI to surface insights and write narrative summaries.

- Use automation tools (e.g. n8n, Make, Zapier) to reduce repetitive manual work and create scalable workflows around campaign management.

- Work closely with the Growth Team and support teams — using AI to speed up collaboration, from briefing creative to aligning on copy.

Who you are:

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves:

- 2+ year of experience managing campaigns on Google Ads, Meta Ads and/or LinkedIn Ads (other platforms are a plus, but not required).

- Knows how to navigate ad platforms, create audiences, choose formats, and optimize campaigns.

- Confident working with data and tracking the main Paid Media KPIs (spreadsheets, Looker Studio, Power BI, platform native reporting tools or similar).

- Active, daily user of AI tools — you use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity or similar tools as part of your real workflow, not just occasionally.

- Can write effective prompts: you know how to give AI models context, constraints and examples to get useful outputs on the first or second try.

- Has experience using AI to produce or improve ad copy, creative briefs, keyword lists, or performance summaries.

- Organized, precise and able to handle multiple campaigns in parallel.

- Comfortable communicating with both technical and non-technical teams.

- Genuinely interested in Paid Media and willing to go deep.

Nice to haves:

- Experience with automation tools like n8n, Make or Zapier to build workflows around paid media tasks.

- Experience building custom GPTs, AI agents, or AI-assisted reporting pipelines.

- Experience with less common platforms (Spotify Ads, programmatic, Uber Ads etc.).

- Interest or experience in AI workflows, internal tooling, or prompt engineering.

- Experience collaborating with creative teams — including using AI to brief or iterate on creative assets.

- Experience working with B2B SaaS or Fintech.

- Experience with MMMs and/or advanced attribution models.

- Basic understanding of landing page CRO, Google Analytics, or CRM tools like HubSpot.

Why Clara

- A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

- Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

- An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

- English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

- Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

- Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

- Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

- Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

- ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

- Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

jobs.summary: About the Role & Team The Payroll Operations Specialist supports the compliance infrastructure that keeps our customers’ payroll operations running smoothly.
jobs.description:
About the Role & Team

The Payroll Operations Specialist supports the compliance infrastructure that keeps our customers’ payroll operations running smoothly. You’ll own operational workflows across state registrations, employer account maintenance, workers’ compensation, business registrations, and related requirements.

You’ll work closely with Payroll Operations, Customer Support, Benefit, government agencies, insurance carriers, and external partners to resolve issues and deliver a strong customer experience.

What You’ll Do

- Own end-to-end workflows across assigned areas, including state registrations, employer account maintenance, workers’ compensation, Foreign Qualification (FQAL), Registered Agent Administration (RAA), Statements of Information (SOI), and related requirements.

- Research state and local requirements and determine the steps needed to establish and maintain employer accounts, business registrations, and coverage.

- Work directly with government agencies, insurance carriers, brokers, and third-party partners to establish accounts, obtain information, and resolve issues.

- Manage account, registration, and policy lifecycle changes, including registrations, updates, state additions, renewals, audits, transfers, and closures.

- Investigate and resolve registration, account access, policy, coverage, and other operational issues.

- Maintain accurate customer records, credentials, documentation, deadlines, and status tracking.

- Communicate requirements, blockers, timelines, and next steps clearly to customers and internal partners.

- Identify recurring issues and improve processes, documentation, controls, and automation.

- Manage a high-volume workload while prioritizing time-sensitive and high-risk work.

- Support other Payroll Operations initiatives and duties as business and team needs evolve.

What We’re Looking For

- 2+ years of experience in payroll operations, state or business registrations, workers’ compensation, insurance operations, compliance operations, or a related field.

- Strong ownership and ability to manage work from intake through resolution with limited oversight.

- Strong research and problem-solving skills, including navigating unfamiliar state requirements, agency websites, and carrier systems.

- Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple deadlines and workflows.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-focused approach.

- Comfortable working directly with government agencies, carriers, vendors, and cross-functional partners.

- Curiosity and willingness to develop deep subject-matter expertise.

You May Be a Great Fit If You Have

- Experience with multi-state employer or business registrations and account maintenance.

- Experience with workers’ compensation policy administration, renewals, audits, or carrier relationships.

- Experience with FQAL, RAA, SOI, or other business compliance filings.

- Experience in payroll, fintech, PEO, benefits, insurance, or another high-growth operational environment.
