jobs.title: Senior Manager, Supplier Performance, Customer Ops & Specialist Services
jobs.summary: 🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
jobs.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰£68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + Benefits ✨

Our Customer Operations & Specialist Services teams⭐

We are recruiting for 4 opportunities across our Customer Operations and Specialist Services teams to join us as Senior Manager in Supplier Performance. We are recruiting for 4 roles, with 1 to join us in each of the following areas: Complaints, VAIB (Vulnerability, Accessibility, Inclusivity and Bereavements), Financial Health and Core Customer Operations.

Outsourcing is key to enabling Monzo to meet its mission of making money work for everyone, as well as driving a cost efficient operation and delivering excellent customer service.

We are changing how we manage our relationships with our outsourcing partners by driving more responsibility and accountability through our Monzo domain leaders. We need a brilliant Seniors Managers to join this new oversight team, reporting directly to the Directors within each business area.

Partner management is moving right into the heart of our domains. You will be our eyes and ears on the ground, making sure our offshore outsource partners feel like a true extension of Monzo and not just an outsourced supplier. We ensure our partners are set up for success and deliver fantastic customer service.

🔑You’ll play a key role by...

You will act as the vital bridge between Monzo and our external partners to ensure they feel like a true extension of our team. You will drive both operational delivery and a brilliant customer experience. Working closely with our site leaders in South Africa, you will manage day to day service delivery while keeping a close eye on quality, customer satisfaction, and risk management. A key part of your role involves translating our strategic business goals into clear, actionable steps for the partner management team so they are fully equipped to succeed. You will support in domain forecasting and rolling out new processes to make sure they actually work on the floor. Ultimately, you will integrate our partner leaders into our regular performance reviews to foster a genuine one team mindset across the operation.

- Leading a dedicated oversight team: You will directly manage a Supplier Operations Partner who wil focus on Operational Delivery like SLAs, schedule adherence, Customer Experience, quality, and fixing the root causes of repeat contacts.

- Managing the partnership day to day: You will work directly with our outsourced partner Operations Managers to ensure the whole domain is delivering the service, customer satisfaction, quality and risk management we expect.

- Acting as the translation layer: You will turn our strategic business goals into practical, actionable steps for the outsouring management team. You will make sure they are equipped to succeed, rather than just telling them when they miss the mark.

- Tracking and managing performance: You will work alongside our partners to oversee all aspects of day to day service management, including handling risk events and stepping in to engage partners directly when performance drifts.

- Forecasting and planning: Alongside WFM you will raise and approve forecast requests and manage the end to end domain forecasting process for our partners.

- Owning change execution: You will handle the end to end definition and execution of change through our partners, ensuring any new processes or solutions are actually fit for purpose on the floor.

- Integrating the teams: You will support the domain Director to embed Teleperformance leaders into our existing domain performance review meetings, fostering a one team mindset.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

- You have proven track record of working closely with or managing global offshore partners and can manage to a customer experience, not just a commercial contract.

- You are deeply analytical mindset with the ability to anchor decisions in rigorous data, translating complex metrics into robust business cases that secure senior stakeholder buy in.

- You have a proven track record of leading through others and can influence, coach, and guide Managers who do not report directly to you.

- You are brilliant at translating complex business goals into simple steps for frontline teams.

- You zoom out when solving operational problems. Don’t just look at the operational team, always think about how your decisions impact the rest of the business.

Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £68,400-86,550 + equity + Incentive Awards tied to your performance

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

Job Title: Patient Support Specialist - Remote

Location: Remote - United States

Employment Type: FT W2

CareTalk Health

CareTalk Health is a fully remote, nationwide virtual medical practice. We partner with Medicare Advantage plans to deliver Annual Wellness Visits and close care gaps, reaching members wherever they are. We believe virtual care isn't a compromise — it's care delivered the way patients actually want it. Our job is to make that experience simple, reliable, and human.

About the Role

We are seeking Patient Support Specialists (PSS) who are the first point of contact for patients in our virtual clinic and play a critical role in ensuring smooth, timely, and high-quality care delivery. The PSS is the starting point of the virtual care experience. They contact scheduled patients, confirm readiness for the visit, and seamlessly coordinate the handoff to the care team. By ensuring smooth patient flow, the PSS plays a critical role in maintaining patient satisfaction, keeping the clinical schedule on track, and delivering an exceptional virtual care experience.

We are hiring for multiple full-time positions. All opportunities are fully remote. The hours are Monday-Friday 9-6pm EST, compensated at a rate of $20 per hour.

What You’ll Do

Key Responsibilities

Care Team Coordination

- Serve as the central coordinator for multiple care teams at once, ensuring patients are connected with the right clinician at the right time.

- Drive patient engagement by keeping the flow of visits moving smoothly across several concurrent schedules.

- Transfer patients to the appropriate care team members using call handling tools and provide real-time intake information.

- Notify the RN when a patient is ready, track the status of each visit, and anticipate next steps to prevent delays.

- Monitor call activity across teams and proactively support timely handoffs from RN to provider.

- Escalate scheduling conflicts, clinical concerns, or patient-related issues promptly to protect care quality and efficiency.

Patient Intake and Check-In

- Initiate outbound calls to scheduled patients to confirm appointments, verify identity, and ensure readiness for the visit.

- Conduct pre-visit intake, including review of demographics, consent, and any required pre-screening questions.

- Perform technology checks when appropriate (e.g., audio, video readiness) to prevent delays during the visit.

- Set a professional, welcoming tone that builds trust and positions the patient for a positive care experience.

- Take inbound calls to assist patients with questions about their visit, scheduling, or technical navigation.

Communication and Documentation

- Maintain accurate documentation of patient outreach, intake, call routing, and handoff activities in the designated system(s).

- Provide real-time updates to the clinical team on patient status and any scheduling adjustments.

- Support patient satisfaction by answering questions or redirecting concerns to the appropriate resource.

Technical Navigation & Support

- Use tools to route patients per clinical workflow.

- Troubleshoot minor technical issues (e.g., patient audio or video) and escalate as needed.

- Communicate with patients and care team members via internal chat or phone to coordinate activities.

Required

- Experience in a healthcare or customer service setting required

- Strong digital fluency and comfort with navigating multiple platforms (Zoom, Teams, EHR/CRM tools)

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

- Ability to multitask, prioritize, and maintain calm in a fast-paced virtual environment

Preferred

- Experience in telehealth, medical office or remote care delivery

- Familiarity with HIPAA and patient privacy regulations

- Bilingual in English and Spanish (or other language) is a plus

Work Location Requirement

This is a remote U.S.-based position. Employees must perform all work physically within the United States. International work is not permitted during scheduled work hours.

Work Environment

This is a remote position and may be “on camera” at any time. The Patient Support Specialist will work from a home office, requiring reliable internet connectivity and a secure, private workspace.

-
Computer:

-
Windows or Apple (macOS) Computer ONLY (NO Chromebooks, Linux Machines, or Smartphones)

-
Must have at least Windows 10 or macOS 14 Sonoma.

-
Hardware:

-
Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Equivalent (Windows); Apple Silicon (Macs)

-
RAM: 16 GB

-
Headphones: Wired headphones required for optimal audio quality. (NO built-in mics)

-

Why CareTalk Health

CareTalk Health is a fast-growing telehealth organization that delivers high-quality virtual care at scale. This role offers the opportunity to shape contractor operations, influence performance outcomes, and support innovative care models across a nationwide clinical workforce.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Atlanta, GA

URL: https://paidadscoaching.com/

The Paid Ads Specialist owns the day-to-day execution of Paid Ads Academy's own paid media, the campaigns that drive traffic and leads into our challenges, masterclasses, and evergreen funnels. You take the targeting, budget, and testing plan the Senior Paid Ads Coach sets and run it: building campaigns, watching spend daily, and reporting on what is working across multiple platforms: Google, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Tiktok, etc.

The Senior Paid Ads Coach owns strategy, budget authority, and the performance thresholds. You own execution: the builds, the daily optimizations inside those thresholds, the tracking hygiene, and the reporting that tells everyone the truth about what happened. A strategy is only as good as the account it runs in.

What makes this different from an agency seat is whose money it is. This is our budget, driving leads into the programs that fund the company. When cost per lead drifts, it is not a client conversation, it is our margin. We also teach paid ads for a living, which means our own accounts should be the strongest example of the work we put in front of students. You will be one of the people who makes that true.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Campaign Execution

- Campaign Build & Launch: Build and launch paid campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok, Spotify, ChatGPT, and YouTube for challenges, masterclasses, and evergreen funnels, following the targeting, budget, and creative testing plan set by the Senior Paid Ads Coach

- Account Hygiene: Keep every account organized with consistent naming conventions, UTM tracking, and pixel and conversion tracking, working with Tech & Automations to keep data clean

- Campaign Audits: Run recurring audits of active accounts to catch structural, targeting, or budget inefficiencies before they compound

- Recruiting Ads: Post and manage paid recruiting ads when new roles go live

Performance Monitoring & Optimization

- Daily Monitoring: Check spend, cost per lead, cost per acquisition, and ROAS daily across all active campaigns

- Optimization: Pause, scale, or adjust campaigns against the performance thresholds the Senior Paid Ads Coach sets, without waiting to be told

- Platform Awareness: Track Meta, Google, and YouTube platform and policy changes that could affect active campaigns, and flag anything the Senior Paid Ads Coach needs to know

- Curriculum Flagging: Flag when a platform change is coming or occurs

- Early Warning: Flag underperformance or tracking issues the same day, before they burn budget

- Occasional Holiday/Weekend Coverage: During an active launch, monitor campaigns as needed during occasional holidays or weekends when the rest of the team is not working. In exchange, we’ll provide flexibility to adjust your schedule and make up that time during the week

- Industry Research: Run ongoing competitive and industry analysis to surface emerging trends, new ad formats, and growth opportunities

Reporting

- Recurring Reporting: Build and maintain the weekly and campaign-level performance reports for the Senior Paid Ads Coach and leadership

- Budget Pacing: Track spend against planned budget for every active campaign so nothing overspends or underspends without a reason

Creative Coordination

- Creative Briefs: Write the creative briefs for new ad concepts, partnering with Brand & Creative to shape assets and call out iteration opportunities as results come in

- Creative Requests: Partner with Brand & Creative and Funnels teams to get ad creative, copy, and landing pages built, tested, and refreshed on schedule

- Test Planning: Contribute ideas to the A/B testing plan for creative, audiences, and landing page experience, based on what you are seeing in the accounts

- Creative Testing: Run the creative and audience tests the Senior Paid Ads Coach prioritizes, and report back what won and why

Content Quality Support

- Curriculum Recommendations and QA: Do a first-pass review of new ad-related training material, checking for accuracy and consistency with current platform behavior and ensure what’s in the training aligns with what’s working and relevant

- Refresh Tracking: Keep a running list of course content that needs a refresh based on platform or strategy changes

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience: 2 to 4 years of hands-on paid media buying, building and managing campaigns directly in Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, YouTube). Can confidently manage a 7-figure annual ad budget across multiple platforms.

- Tracking & Attribution: Comfortable with pixels, UTMs, and conversion tracking, and knows how to troubleshoot when the numbers do not add up

- Analytical: Comfortable working in Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Excel, and can read a report and know what to do next, not just pull the numbers

- Detail & Organization: Manages multiple active campaigns and deadlines at once without letting tracking, optimization, or reporting standards slip

- Communication: Flags issues and opportunities early rather than waiting to be asked, and can explain what happened in a campaign in plain language.

- Fast moving: Advocates for the businesses’ best interest, including making budget decisions, optimization decisions, and creative decisions. Swiftly moves and takes action based on data and not feelings.

NICE TO HAVE

- Additional platform experience: TikTok, Reddit, Spotify, ChatGPT, LinkedIn Ads, Amazon Ads, App Ads

- Experience supporting A/B testing and optimization across audiences, creative, bidding, and landing pages

- Experience running lead-gen ads for challenges, webinars, or launches specifically

- Experience in online education, coaching, or membership businesses

- Experience working with agency partners or cross-functional teams

- Familiarity with GoHighLevel (GHL)

- Google Ads and other platform certifications

WHO THRIVES IN THIS ROLE

- Owns the Account: You treat ad spend like it is your own money and you do not need someone looking over your shoulder to catch a problem. When something is off, you have usually already found it and started working the fix.

- Fast and Disciplined: You move quickly on optimizations but you do not skip the reporting and tracking hygiene to get there. Speed that breaks attribution is not speed, because nobody can tell what worked afterward.

- Initiates: You see a trend or a problem before anyone points it out, and you act on it. You read the platform release notes, you notice a format change before it shows up in your results, and you have a point of view about what to do with it.

- Comfortable Inside a Lane: Strategy, budget authority, and the performance thresholds sit with the Senior Paid Ads Coach. You can run hard inside those thresholds without either overstepping them or waiting to be told what to do next.

- Bothered by Bad Data: An untagged campaign, a broken pixel, or a number that does not reconcile sits with you until it is resolved. You would rather stop and get it right than publish a report you do not fully trust.

- Plain-Spoken About Performance: You can explain what happened in an account to someone who does not buy media, without hiding a bad week behind jargon. Good news and bad news travel at the same speed.

EMPLOYMENT TYPE & OUTSIDE WORK

This is a full-time role, and we're looking for people who are all in. That means this is the work, not one of a few things you're juggling.

To protect focus and prevent burnout, we don't permit outside work or side gigs for full-time team members. If you currently run a business or have a commitment you're not looking to step away from, this likely isn't the right fit, and that's okay. We'd rather be upfront so we're aligned from the start.

We've found the people who thrive here are the ones whose energy and vision are fully on this business. That focus is what helps the whole team win.

Please note: applicants must reside within the US to be considered.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

- Base Salary: $65,000-$75,000 per year, depending on experience

- Flexible PTO: Flexible time off after 6 months, plus company-wide holidays

- Retirement Plan: 401(k) with employer match after 6 months

- Profit-Sharing 401(k): Employer-funded contributions based on tenure and other plan factors, with a 3-year vesting schedule

- Paid Parental Leave: 12 weeks fully paid to the primary provider and 4 weeks fully paid to the secondary provider (eligibility based on length of service)

- Wardrobe Stipend: $2,000 first-year bonus for business attire

- Home Office Stipend: $500 to create a productive remote workspace

- Annual Incentive Trip: Fully-paid team trip to a bucket-list destination

- Wellness Benefit: Georgia-based employees receive monthly access to our private Wellness Center (gym, sauna, and cold plunge). Employees outside Georgia receive a monthly wellness stipend (up to $50 per month) through reimbursement.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: New York, New York, United States

URL: https://www.billiontoone.com

A Rare Opportunity to Shape the Future of Genomics

Join a team of brilliant, passionate innovators determined to transform healthcare. At BillionToOne, we've built a category-defining, publicly traded company on Nasdaq where transparency fuels trust, collaboration drives breakthroughs, and every contribution moves the needle on our mission to make life-changing diagnostics accessible to all. We don't just aim for incremental improvements; we build products that are 10x better than anything that exists today.

Our scientists, engineers, sales executives, and visionaries are united by an unwavering commitment to changing the standard of care in prenatal and cancer diagnostics. This is where cutting-edge science meets human compassion, and every innovation you contribute helps remove the fear of the unknown from some of life's most critical medical moments.

If you're driven by purpose, energized by innovation, and ready to help shape the future of precision medicine at scale, this is where you belong.

We are looking for a Client Services Associate I, Oncology (East Coast) to provide exceptional service and support to BillionToOne's customers. This role is part of a broader Client Services organization.

The Client Services Associate holds a pivotal role in the organization as he/she will act as the face of BillionToOne for our customers including physicians, Oncology clinics, patients, clinical and auxiliary staff. The CSA will be on the front lines of all internal and external customer inquiries supporting BillionToOne’s Oncology tests. The ideal candidate for this role is an ambitious and intelligent individual who is highly self-motivated and can effortlessly help drive and influence a positive patient and customer experience. The Client Services Associate I is a full-time remote position and reports to the Client Services Manager.

Working hours are Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM to 4:30 PM ET.

Responsibilities:

- Engage customers in a positive and courteous manner to resolve issues and deliver the best possible customer experience.

- Oversee and effectively respond to all types of communication in a professional and articulate manner: phone, email, and web inquiries from customers (physician offices), sales representatives, and patients.

- Handle a variety of inquiries, including questions about our technology, products, and services, status of test results, costs, billing, and insurance coverage.

- Keep precise and clear documentation of all communications and follow-up activities.

- Collaborate with our laboratory to ensure that client information is accurately maintained and help to ensure the timely delivery of test results.

- Contact physicians and other medical personnel to obtain missing information from test orders.

- Enter and qualify new customer information into CRM and LIMS systems.

- Identify issues and trends and collaborate with commercial leadership to develop best practices for internal and external processes.

- Participate in cross-functional projects that extend beyond routine responsibilities to contribute to building a world-class Customer Service organization.

- Represent the organization during intra-department meetings or All Hands meetings as needed.

Qualifications:

- 1+ years of prior client-facing experience.

- 4-year college degree (or equivalent in experience).

- Experience with CRM tools (Salesforce, Zendesk, etc.) is a plus.

- Advanced organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple assignments simultaneously.

- Ability to work in a very fast-paced, demanding environment.

- Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills - ability to effectively tailor messages to different audiences.

- Passion for creating a delightful experience for internal and external customers.

- Ability to analyze complex situations independently and implement appropriate solutions.

Nice-To-Haves:

- Proficiency or fluency in Spanish to effectively assist our diverse customer base and ensure a seamless patient and client experience.

- Customer service experience in diagnostic laboratory setting.

Benefits And Perks:

- Working alongside brilliant, kind, passionate and dedicated colleagues, in an empowering environment, toward a global vision, striving for a future in which transformative molecular diagnostics can help millions of patients

- Open, transparent culture that includes weekly Town Hall meetings

- The ability to indirectly or directly change the lives of hundreds of thousands patients

- Multiple medical benefit options; employee premiums paid 100% of select plans, dependents covered up to 80%

- Extremely generous Family Bonding Leave for eligible employees (16 weeks, paid at 100%)

- Supplemental fertility benefits coverage

- Retirement savings program including a 4% Company match

- Increase paid time off with increased tenure

- Latest and greatest hardware (laptop, lab equipment, facilities)

At BillionToOne, we are proud to offer a combination of (1) competitive base pay, (2) corporate bonus program, on top of (3) industry leading company benefits (free healthcare options, 401k match, very generous fully paid parental leave, etc.).

The base pay rate for this role is $29.34 per hour. This position is eligible for an annual bonus. Together, the total four-year value of base and target bonus is up to approximately $269,000. We also offer competitive medical and dental coverage and a 401(k) with company match.

BillionToOne is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
For more information about how we protect your information, we encourage you to review our Privacy Policy.

BillionToOne is a next-generation molecular diagnostics company on a mission to make powerful, accurate diagnostic tests accessible to everyone. Our revolutionary QCT molecular counting technology enhances disease detection resolution by over a thousandfold using cell-free DNA,a breakthrough that has already transformed the lives of over half a million patients worldwide.

Our Impact

Unity Complete™ is the only non-invasive prenatal screen capable of assessing fetal risk for both common recessive conditions and aneuploidies from a single maternal blood sample.
Unity Confirm™ enables non-invasive confirmation for high-risk screening results through the capture of intact circulating fetal cells using BillionToOne’s Fetal Cell Capture™ Technology.
Our Northstar® liquid biopsy test uniquely combines treatment selection with real-time monitoring, giving oncologists unprecedented precision in cancer care.

Our Growth

From $0 to $400M+ annualized revenue run-rate in just 6 years. In 2025, we completed one of the most successful IPOs for a medical diagnostics company, building on nearly $400M in private funding,including our $130M Series D in 2024 and backed by world-class investors including Hummingbird, Adams Street Partners, Neuberger Berman, Baillie Gifford, and Premji Invest.

Our Recognition

jobs.title: IT Support Specialist - APAC
jobs.summary: Smartly is looking for a proactive and customer-focused IT Support Specialist to join our Global IT team and help strengthen technical support across the APAC region.
jobs.description:
Smartly is looking for a proactive and customer-focused IT Support Specialist to join our Global IT team and help strengthen technical support across the APAC region.

In this role, you will provide hands-on and remote technical support to employees across multiple locations, troubleshooting hardware, software, identity and access, and connectivity issues. You will primarily support macOS and Windows environments while working with enterprise applications, device management platforms, and cloud-based technologies.

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, takes ownership of their work, and can operate independently while collaborating with a globally distributed team.

This position plays an important role in expanding our early-morning APAC support coverage, particularly for employees in Australia, Singapore, the Philippines, India, and China.

As an IT Support Specialist, You Will:

- Provide Regional IT Support: Deliver timely and reliable technical assistance across APAC, with a focus on early business hours in Australia and Southeast Asia.

- Troubleshoot Technical Issues: Diagnose and resolve macOS, Windows, mobile device, hardware, software, networking, and application-related issues.

- Own Support Requests: Manage IT tickets from initial investigation through resolution, ensuring proper prioritization, documentation, communication, and follow-through.

- Support Employee Onboarding and Offboarding: Coordinate device provisioning, account creation, access management, and equipment returns.

- Manage Enterprise IT Systems: Assist with Google Workspace, identity and access management, endpoint management, and other internal IT platforms.

- Support Regional Offices and Leadership: Provide professional and responsive IT assistance to employees, Workplace teams, and regional leadership.

- Collaborate Globally: Work with IT colleagues across APAC, EMEA, and the Americas to ensure effective communication, escalation, and handovers.

- Improve IT Processes: Maintain documentation, contribute to our knowledge base, identify recurring issues, and recommend improvements to support workflows.

- Take Initiative and Ownership: Independently investigate and resolve technical issues, proactively communicate blockers, and escalate complex situations when appropriate.

We're Definitely Looking for You If You Have:

- 3+ years of relevant experience in IT Support, Service Desk, or IT Operations.

- Strong hands-on troubleshooting experience with macOS and Windows in a corporate environment.

- Experience with enterprise identity and access management, including user provisioning, SSO, MFA, and account permissions.

- Familiarity with Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, or similar enterprise administration platforms.

- Experience using IT ticketing systems, managing competing priorities, and following issues through to resolution.

- Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi, and basic connectivity troubleshooting.

- Familiarity with endpoint management, device security, and basic IT compliance practices.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills and a strong customer-service mindset.

- Ability to work independently, troubleshoot unfamiliar problems, and make sound decisions with limited supervision.

- Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to communication.

- Ability to work the designated early APAC shift and collaborate effectively with colleagues across global time zones.

It's a Plus If You Have:

- Experience with MDM solutions such as Jamf, Kandji/Iru, Microsoft Intune, or Workspace ONE.

- Hands-on experience administering Google Workspace.

- Experience supporting Apple devices in a predominantly macOS environment.

- Familiarity with Slack administration and enterprise SaaS applications.

- Experience with IT automation or scripting using Bash, PowerShell, or similar technologies.

- Experience supporting iOS and Android devices in a corporate environment.

- Experience providing IT support to senior executives.

- Experience supporting distributed offices or working within a global IT team.

- Familiarity with ITIL principles and IT service management best practices.

Why Join Us?

You'll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on how IT services are delivered across our APAC region.

As part of a global IT team, you'll gain exposure to a broad range of enterprise technologies, collaborate with colleagues around the world, and contribute to improving our processes and employee experience.

We value curiosity, initiative, accountability, and continuous learning. This is an opportunity for someone who wants to grow beyond traditional service desk responsibilities, take ownership of meaningful challenges, and help shape a reliable and scalable IT support environment.

Apply Now and Shape Your Future with Smartly!
About Smartly

Smartly is the AI-powered advertising technology company transforming ad experiences for brands and their consumers. Our comprehensive advertising platform seamlessly integrates the capabilities of media, creative, and intelligence to power more than 800 billion impressions and generate more than 300 billion creatives annually, delivering tangible business outcomes for brands and advertisers.

Smartly is the only company in the industry recognized as a Leader in The Forrester Wave: Creative Advertising Technologies with PwC validating the results it delivers for brands. We manage creative and media for 700+ brands worldwide and $6B in ad spend across the largest media platforms, including Facebook, Google, Instagram, Pinterest, Snap, and TikTok. Our end-to-end technology, unmatched access to media platforms and exceptional customer service help Fortune 500 brands to reach and engage consumers and learn what performs best.Smartly is a multinational and diverse team of 750+ Smartlies from 60+ nationalities, working in 13 countries. Together, we want to create and maintain an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and heard. Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion approach is at the heart of it.

Visit Smartly to learn more.

The processing of your information is described in our Candidate Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Red Team Specialist
jobs.summary: Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time: Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina.
jobs.description:
Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time:

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário:

- Planejar e executar operações ofensivas (Red Team engagements, Adversary Simulation/Emulation) contra a infraestrutura, aplicações e processos do iFood Pago, simulando adversários reais com foco em impacto financeiro.

- Realizar testes de segurança em aplicações web, APIs (REST/GraphQL/gRPC) e aplicações mobile (Android e iOS), incluindo análise estática, dinâmica e de runtime.

- Realizar testes e avaliar a segurança de ambientes cloud-native, incluindo Kubernetes, containers, service meshes.

- Conduzir testes de segurança em sistemas AI-powered, identificando vulnerabilidades como prompt injection, model manipulation, data poisoning, bypass de guardrails, entre outras.

- Desenvolver automações, ferramentas ofensivas e integrações utilizando AI/LLMs para escalar processos e aprimorar a identificação e exploração de vulnerabilidades.

- Documentar findings com clareza, demonstrando impacto real ao negócio e propondo planos de ações para correção.

- Colaborar com Blue Team e CSIRT em exercícios de Purple Team, contribuindo para melhoria contínua de detecção e resposta.

- Manter-se atualizado sobre TTPs emergentes, especialmente aquelas direcionadas ao setor financeiro e de pagamentos na América Latina.

Ingredientes Que Buscamos:

- Experiência em Red Team operations e Penetration Testing em ambientes corporativos.

- Domínio em testes de segurança de aplicações web e APIs, incluindo vulnerabilidades além do OWASP Top 10 (broken authentication, mass assignment, BOLA/IDOR, race conditions, business logic flaws em fluxos financeiros).

- Experiência em segurança mobile (Android/iOS): reversing de APKs/IPAs, hooking com Frida, bypass de certificate pinning, análise de armazenamento local, etc.

- Conhecimento prático em segurança de ambientes cloud-native: Kubernetes (RBAC, pod escape, service account abuse), Docker (container breakout), AWS/GCP (privilege escalation, misconfiguration exploitation).

- Experiência com infraestrutura de Red Team: C2 frameworks (Cobalt Strike, Sliver, custom C2), redirectors, OPSEC, evasão e persistência.

- Habilidade em programação e scripting (Python, Go, Bash) para desenvolvimento de tooling ofensivo e automações.

- Conhecimento do MITRE ATT&CK Framework e capacidade de mapear operações a TTPs relevantes.

- Familiaridade com protocolos e sistemas financeiros é um diferencial forte.

- Traduzir findings técnicos em risco de negócio para diferentes audiências.

Para Realçar o Sabor:

- Experiência em testes de segurança de sistemas baseados em LLMs/AI (prompt injection, jailbreaking, tool-use abuse, data exfiltration via AI agents).

- Uso de AI/LLMs para automação de tarefas ofensivas (triagem de vulnerabilidades, geração de payloads, análise de código, reconhecimento automatizado).

- Participação em programas de bug bounty com track record relevante.

- Publicação de pesquisas, CVEs, write-ups ou palestras em conferências de segurança.

- Certificações relevantes (OSCP, OSEP, OSWE, CRTO, CARTE, CRT, eMAPT).

- Experiência prévia em fintechs, bancos ou empresas de pagamentos.

Buscamos uma pessoa apaixonada por segurança da informação, que esteja sempre em busca de novos aprendizados e que goste de desafios. Se você se identifica com este perfil, adoraríamos conhecer você!

jobs.description:
About us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

The role

This is a key role in the Financial Control team. We are responsible for the month-end close, the preparation of financial accounts, and play a key role in delivering audits. Reporting to the Finance Manager, you will be an Assistant Management Accountant with experience delivering month-end activities and performing P&L and balance sheet reconciliations.

What excites you

Ownership:

- Own the preparation and posting of monthly journals such as accruals, prepayments and adjustments across all entities.

- Own key balance sheet accounts across the group, completing monthly reconciliations and resolving variances in a timely, documented manner

Collaboration:

- Work closely with teams across the business, including AP, Tax and Management Reporting

- Supporting the Finance Manager when required

- Assist with the annual audits in preparation and provide the requested documents

Analysis:

- Produce P&L variance analysis and commentary

What must you have

- Experience in a financial control or management accounting environment

- Use Excel or Google Sheets with confidence

- Show attention to detail

- Be a team player, with ability to work independently

What might you have

- Perform multi-currency balance sheet reconciliations, ideally across multiple entities

- Familiar with NetSuite and FloQast apps

- Communicate confidently with internationally based stakeholders

- Hold an accounting qualification

- Use AI to identify process efficiencies

- Ability to prioritise time and stay organised in a fast-paced environment

Base salary range: € 25,600- € 38,400 (gross), (including 13th and 14th salary).

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point (€ 25,600 - € 32,000) of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.
(some of) The good stuff

- Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover

- Lunch- based on the location, you either get a meal voucher or a paid lunch when working from the office

- Work away scheme - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 20 working days in any 12-month period

- Adaptive Working - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle

- Parental leave - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure

- Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget

- Time off - generous holiday allowance + volunteer days for ERG events + one day off if you need to move house

Life at GoCardless

We're an organisation defined by our values; We start with why before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We make it happen, working with urgency and taking personal accountability for getting things done. We act with integrity, always. We care deeply about what we do and we know it's essential that we be humble whilst we do it. Our Values form part of the GoCardless DNA, and are used to not only help us nurture and develop our culture, but to deliver impactful work that will help us to achieve our vision.

Diversity & Inclusion

As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.

To ensure that we're representative of the world around us - and to be able to review relevant benchmarks - we ask GeeCees to voluntarily disclose diversity data. This year, the proportion of GeeCees providing data increased to 88% (up from 79% in 2024). With regards to diversity within GoCardless, we can see GeeCees identifying as:

Asian, Black, Mixed or Other — 25%

Neurodiverse — 9%

LGBTQIA+ — 9%

Disabled — 1%

Average age — 33

Female — 45%

Male — 55%

We’re rooting for you during your application and GoCardless aims to provide reasonable adjustments to make our recruitment process as remarkable and accessible as we can. Please speak to your Talent Partner if you need extra support.

If you want to learn more, you can read about our Employee Resource Groups and objectives here

Sustainability

We’re committed to reducing our impact on the environment, leaving a more sustainable world for future generations. Check out our sustainability action plan here.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Specialist - Hybrid
jobs.summary: Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation.
jobs.description:
Clara is the leading platform in Latin America for companies to execute and manage every payment operation. More than 50,000 leading and fast-growing businesses run on our corporate cards, bill pay, financing and B2B payments, and in 2025 the Financial Times named Clara the region’s fastest-growing company. We’re passionate about helping every company we work with become more effective—and, through that, raising the region’s competitiveness. We’re ~400 people, backed by Notable Capital, Coatue, Kaszek, monashees, DST Global, ICONIQ, General Catalyst and Goldman Sachs, among others.

Product Marketing Specialist, Brasil

Ready to accelerate your career?

Clara is the fastest-growing company in Latin America. We've built the leading solution for companies to make and manage all their payments. We already help over 20,000 large and growing businesses operate with agility and financial clarity through locally issued corporate cards, bill pay, financing, and a powerful B2B platform built for scale.

Clara is backed by some of the most successful investors in the world, including top regional VCs like monashees, Kaszek, and Canary, and leading global funds like Notable Capital, Coatue, DST Global Partners, ICONIQ Growth, General Catalyst, Citi Ventures, SV Angel, Citius, Endeavor Catalyst, and Goldman Sachs, in addition to dozens of angel investors and local family offices.

We're building the financial infrastructure that powers high-performing organizations across the region. Join us if you want a fast-paced environment that will accelerate your career, alongside a passionate and committed team distributed across the Americas.

What you'll do

You'll own product marketing execution for Brazil: messaging, launches, sales enablement, and content that turns product capability into a story the Brazilian market believes. You'll work closely with the Head of Product Marketing & GTM, LatAm, and use AI to produce at a pace a small team shouldn't be able to match.

Your responsibilities

- Localize and adapt global positioning and messaging for Brazil, accounting for local market dynamics, competitors, and buyer language, not just translation.

- Execute go-to-market for product launches and features in Brazil: enablement materials, customer communications, and launch content.

- Build and maintain sales enablement assets: battlecards, FAQs, objection handling, and competitive comparisons for the Brazilian sales team.

- Use AI Building processes daily to accelerate production: drafting content, generating messaging variants, researching competitors, and turning briefs into usable assets quickly.

- Track and report on the metrics that show whether messaging and launches are working: activation, win rates, sales feedback, and content performance.

- Partner with Growth Marketing and Sales in Brazil to keep narrative and campaigns aligned with what's actually happening in the market.

- Monitor Brazilian fintech competitors and feed intelligence back into positioning and enablement.

Must haves

- 2-4 years in product marketing, growth marketing, or a closely related function.

- Strong storyteller: writing samples or work you can point to that turned a product fact into a clear, persuasive narrative.

- Analytical: comfortable working with data to judge whether messaging or a launch actually worked.

- Active, daily use of AI Building tools as part of your real workflow.

- Native or fluent Portuguese, strong written and spoken English.

- Based in Brasil, with a working understanding of the Brazilian B2B buyer and competitive landscape.

- Organized and able to execute independently once direction is set.

Nice to haves

- Fintech, payments, or B2B SaaS experience.

- Startup experience, where you've had to move fast with limited resources.

- Experience building AI-assisted research, content, or enablement workflows.

- Experience working with global or distributed marketing teams.

Why Clara

- A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

- Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

- An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

- English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

- Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

- Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

- Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

- Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

- ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

- Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.summary: CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites.
jobs.description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

- Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands

- Skincare and beauty

- Tech and software

- Finance and investing

- Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability

- Education

- Home improvement

- Automobiles and motorcycles

- Health and wellness

- Medical and clinical fields

- Digital marketing

- SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities

- Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites

- Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy

- Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors

- Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices

- Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing

- Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications

- Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills

- 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred

- Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices

- Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics

- Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content

- Portfolio featuring published work preferred

- Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

Headquarters: United States, Remote

Job Title: People Operations Coordinator - Temp to FTE Opportunity, 3 month contract

Job Location: United States, Remote

This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Salesloft, our People Operations Coordinator is foundational to a high-performing People team. Each coordinator embeds with their assigned business function(s) (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, Sales) to provide full employee lifecycle support, from offer through exit. As the first point of contact for employees and managers, coordinators deliver high-volume, high-accuracy service across HR transactions, data, leave, employee relations support, and employee questions, creating a consistently excellent employee experience. They partner closely with People Business Partners, keeping the work moving, the data clean, and the PBP fully informed, and work alongside Total Rewards, Benefits and Mobility, and Talent Acquisition so programs run smoothly.

Each coordinator also serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing local compliance knowledge, language, and time zone coverage to the team. Working within a shared services model, coordinators cover for one another across functions during peak periods and absences, and bring back improvements that strengthen the whole team. This is a broad, high-visibility role and a clear path toward People Business Partner or People Operations leadership.

About 60 - 70% of your time supports your assigned business function(s) and their People Business Partner. That includes lifecycle transactions, employee data, questions, ER support, and the people programs for your pod.

The remaining 30–40% supports the broader People team. You will help Total Rewards with compensation and benefits cycles, partner with People Systems on HiBob, data, and reporting, and support Talent Acquisition through the handoff from offer to onboarding. You’ll also serve as the expert for your assigned country and cover for teammates during peak periods.

The balance shifts with the business calendar. Expect more Total Rewards work during open enrollment and compensation cycles, for example. We review it regularly throughout the year.

This role begins as a three-month contract with the opportunity to convert to a full-time, permanent Salesloft position based on business needs and performance. The contract period gives you the chance to learn the team, the systems and the business function you support, and gives us the chance to work together before making a long-term commitment. We will check in with you along the way so you know how things are going.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

- Lifecycle Administration. Manages the employee lifecycle for the assigned business function, from offer through exit. Prepares offer letters, coordinates background checks and I-9 and right-to-work verification, and runs onboarding and offboarding, including exit surveys, so every transition is accurate and on time.

- Employee Data & Records. Maintains accurate employee data in HiBob and ADP for the assigned business function. Processes hires, changes, promotions, transfers, terminations, and org updates, and audits records and personnel files to keep data clean and audit-ready.

- HR Case Management. Serves as the first point of contact for employee and manager questions through people@ and HappyFox. Resolves routine requests promptly and escalates complex or sensitive issues to People Business Partners and specialists.

- Mobility, & Benefits Support. Serves as the first point of contact for benefits questions and partners closely with the Benefits and Mobility Specialist to keep PBPs informed on mobility cases.

- PBP, ER & Programs Support.

- PBP Partnership & Employee Relations Support. Partners with the assigned People Business Partner through weekly syncs, sharing context so they have full visibility without having to ask. Supports ER cases under PBP direction by maintaining documentation and the ER tracker, coordinating investigation logistics, and preparing PIP and termination paperwork.

- Program administration: Project manages the promotion process for the assigned business function, tracking and documenting each promotion through processing. Supports compensation cycle execution and submits roles for compensation analysis, following up with leaders and tracking turnaround.

- Survey, QBR & Talent Support. Manages the engagement survey in the system and compiles data and pre-reads for leadership reviews. Supports the QBR process and prepares data and insights for talent calibration conversations.

- Reporting, Analytics & Compliance Support. Fulfills data requests and runs standard reports and headcount reconciliations, providing analysis that supports business reviews and People programs. Supports audits, country-specific filings, I-9 compliance, record retention, and policy acknowledgments, and manages vendor invoices.

- Process Improvement. Establishes and maintains SOPs so the team delivers consistent service across pods. Flags recurring case themes and tests HRIS and workflow changes, turning patterns from the assigned business function into improvements for the whole team.

- Country Expertise. Serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing knowledge of local employment practices and compliance requirements, along with language and time zone coverage. Reviews country-specific documents prepared by other coordinators, supports local filings and vendor relationships, and keeps the team current on changes in local requirements.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We are looking for a service-minded, detail-obsessed People professional who takes pride in getting the work right the first time. You understand that every offer letter, record update, and employee question is someone’s experience of the company, and you treat each one that way. You are comfortable being the first point of contact for employees and managers, and you know when to resolve a request yourself and when to bring in a People Business Partner or specialist. You handle confidential information with discretion and communicate clearly in writing. You are equally at home working through a high volume of transactions and spotting the pattern behind them, and you bring ideas back that make the whole team better. You enjoy partnering with business leaders, adapt easily across time zones and cultures, and want to build toward a career as a People Business Partner or in People Operations leadership.

THE TEAM:

Our People Operations Coordinators, PBPs and specialists work as one team on a shared goal, and each role has clear ownership. Coordinators are the front door of the People organization: warm, responsive and exact, with the pride in getting it right that earns managers’ and employees’ trust. We are a global team across India, Mexico and the United States, we cover for one another, and we share what we learn so every pod gets better. We take on hard problems together, and we hold ourselves to a high bar for accountability, empathy and execution.Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired

Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired

THE SKILL SET:

- 2-4 years in HR operations, shared services, or HR administration

- Hands-on HRIS experience and a case management tool (JIRA, happy fox, service now, etc.)

- Strong attention to detail, discretion with confidential data, and clear written communication

- Comfort supporting business leaders and managers, and working across time zones and cultures

- Exposure to global employment practices and multi-country HR administration is preferred

- Experience supporting a high-growth or sales-led organization is preferred

- Experience with process documentation, reporting, or workflow automation is preferred

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from @ salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

jobs.description:

What you'll do

We're hiring a Sales Enablement Specialist in Sales Operations to own the Sales Academy, from onboarding through a three-month ramp and ongoing enablement. You'll build its curriculum, performance measurement and AI-powered app so new hires can turn learning into sales results.

- Connect learning to sales performance. Unify module completion, test scores and certifications with activity, pipeline and conversion metrics in new-hire scorecards. Report knowledge absorption trends, performance correlations and curriculum gaps to Sales leadership.

- Build a self-service Academy app. Create a central hub where new hires access learning paths, complete modules and assessments, and track progress, while sales leaders monitor ramp performance in real time.

- Personalize learning with AI. Use performance patterns to adapt learning paths, surface at-risk indicators and generate coaching suggestions. Own the app roadmap and ongoing improvements.

- Support reliable HubSpot administration. Handle account assignments, reassignments and territory or segment changes. Resolve ownership disputes while maintaining accurate account data.

- Maintain the Sales book of business. Own uploads and ongoing maintenance in HubSpot, ensuring accurate ownership and segmentation. Monitor and report adherence to assigned accounts and operational workflows.

How you'll work

You'll partner with Sales leadership and subject matter experts to turn real examples, strong call recordings and proven plays into training. Run end-of-cohort retrospectives with new hires and their sales leaders to improve the Academy.

Build with AI and no-code/low-code tools without depending on engineering resources, connecting HubSpot, Amplemarket and Slack data with learning progress. Use that evidence to prioritize app and curriculum improvements.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements for the role. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Must haves

- Experience in sales enablement, learning and development, or sales operations, including designing and delivering onboarding or training.

- Instructional design and facilitation that make knowledge usable across experience levels.

- HubSpot administration, data management and reporting.

- Hands-on daily AI use to build workflows or tools with ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or similar.

- No-code/low-code building with n8n, Bubble, Glide or similar platforms.

- Advanced Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, VLOOKUPs and logical functions.

- Experience with LMS or enablement platforms such as Notion, Lessonly or similar.

- Ability to translate performance data into curriculum decisions and build structured programs from scratch, with careful ownership of content and data quality.

Nice to haves

- Previous experience managing internal tools or apps through ongoing improvements.

- A good sense of humor.

Why Clara

- A high talent-density team driven to make an impact in Latin America — low ego, high ownership.

- Competitive salary and stock options (ESOP) from day one.

- An annual learning budget and accelerated development paths.

- English is our working language, with Spanish and Portuguese every day.

How we work

- Clarity — Open and direct communication: we say what we mean and give context where it matters.

- Simplicity — If it can be simpler, it should be.

- Ownership — We own everything we do, end to end. When something needs to happen, we don't wait.

- Pride — We hold ourselves to a high standard, and it shows in what we deliver.

- ABC (Always Be Changing) — We adapt fast, embrace change, and keep learning.

- Inclusivity — Diverse ideas, stories and perspectives build a better Clara.

If you meet the must-haves, apply — the nice-to-haves are a bonus, not a requirement.

jobs.description:
For the longest time, banking* has only really served one purpose, holding money securely. In doing so, it’s also slowed us down and overcomplicated things. That’s where Mercury comes in. Banking should do more and we’re on a mission to make that happen through powerful banking solutions and simplifying all of the financial workflows that come with managing a business. To accomplish this end, we also need to ensure the trust and safety of our customers, partners and ecosystem. Thankfully, Mercury has a world class Risk team to detect and mitigate any threats. And this team is growing. We’re looking to bring on a Risk User Experience Specialist to make risk decisions in response to risk-related user inquiries, all while providing best-in-class user experiences.

As a Risk User Experience Specialist, you’ll be responsible for responding to transaction limit request increases, making risk decisions on queued payments and check deposits, and leveraging your general risk knowledge to escalate unusual or high risk behavior to relevant teams. You’ll be responsible for providing great user experiences to Mercury users while making highly efficient and high quality risk assessments. You will report directly to the Risk User Experience Lead and will be supported by a highly functional team.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Schedule Information:

Required: This position requires you to be able to work on the weekends in addition to weekdays

- This position will be full time working Sunday - Thursday shift, with standard working hours (8am-5pm local time)

- Your working schedule will be fixed - this is not a rotating shift

Here are some things you’ll do on the job:

- Respond to limit request increases from high and moderate risk users, while reviewing account and transactional activity, to determine if aligned with expected account usage

- Review Overlimit transactions through a dedicated queue, evaluating account history and risk signals, and requesting supporting documentation as needed, to approve or reject within required cutoff times

- Review and decision remote check deposits submitted by users utilizing internal tools, and third party systems

- Manage a high-volume caseload within service level agreements and with critical attention to detail

- Respond to Risk support requests in the mailbox and Slack channels, related to limit increases, and other account operations inquiries from financial partners, users, or other internal/external parties

- Partner with our BPO team by providing second opinions and exception guidance on escalated reviews for both check deposits and overlimit transactions

- Document rationale for risk decisions with supporting documentation

- Write clear documentation on current processes and help train future teammates

- Identify opportunities to make processes more observable, scalable, and efficient through tooling changes and procedure updates

- Maintain a positive user experience, while mitigating any potential fraud loss or risk to Mercury

You should:

- Have experience working in banking, fintech, or other financial services

- Have 2-3 years of experience working in the risk space

- Have product sense and knowledge of banking products (e.g., ACH, International Wires, SWIFT, checks, and debit card)

- Exercise empathy and understanding when communicating with users

- Manage relationships with external parties with confidence and kindness

- Act as a generalist by assessing various types of risk when making decisions

- Work with efficiency and focus

- Write with clarity and purpose

- Prioritize requests and keep track of follow-ups

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Waterloo, Canada

URL: https://careers.freshlycommerce.com/

At Freshly Commerce, we're on a mission to build the logistics brain for commerce. Today, we help 25,000 Shopify brands simplify gnarly workflows like inventory, bundling, and order fulfillment (for even the world's largest brands like Sennheiser, Godiva, YAMAHA, and Stanley Drinkware). Tomorrow, we'll deliver intelligent automation that feels like an on-site operations team so merchants can focus on building their brand.

We're a fully-remote and bootstrapped company with teammates around the world. We love what we do and love who we build for. We're a small team of 9 (3 Support specialists) who amplify each other's work by working closely together: dev with support, support with marketing, and so on. We're curious, kind, scrappy yet rigorous, and highly intentional. If this sounds like the type of team you'd like to be a part of, we'd love to hear from you.

About this role

In this role, you'll have significant ownership of your work, make impactful decisions daily, and report directly to the founders. This is a full-time remote position open to candidates in all timezones.

Support is the foundation of everything we do. Our apps have consistently maintained high ratings on the Shopify App Store because our support team genuinely cares about helping merchants succeed. As one of our early support hires, you'll get to know our products inside and out and become a go-to expert on how things work under the hood.

We hire slowly and keep the bar high, so the people you work with every day will be some of the best you’ve worked with. You'll be joining a small but growing support team, where we all wear many hats. You'll need strong troubleshooting instincts, a curious mind, and a willingness to get into the weeds. You should feel comfortable making judgment calls on UX or product questions, and know when something needs to be escalated. There's plenty of room to grow with us.

What we're looking for

- Somone who fixes the process while you’re fixing the ticket.

- Someone who's comfortable diving into technical issues and can confidently support merchants over email and through clear, helpful video recordings.

- A strong track record in customer-facing roles, with a focus on delivering thoughtful, efficient support. You listen closely, ask the right questions, and know how to turn a frustrating situation into a positive experience.

- Good judgment around what needs to be escalated and what doesn't. You'll know when to loop in teammates and how to make that handoff seamless for the merchant.

- An eye for patterns and the ability to turn merchant feedback into actionable insights for our product and engineering teams.

- The ability to prioritize effectively. You can assess what's urgent, what's important, and what can wait, especially when everything feels like it needs attention.

- Comfort with change. You stay calm when the product evolves and enjoy picking up new knowledge as you go.

- A team-first mindset. You jump in to support others, document what you've learned, and share what's working so we can all move faster together.

- Strong communication skills, especially in writing. You know how to keep things clear, friendly, and easy to follow, whether you're talking to a merchant or a teammate.

- Natural troubleshooting instincts. You enjoy working on tricky issues and figuring out what's actually going on, not just treating the symptoms.

- Great attention to detail. You care about getting the small things right, because they add up to a better experience.

- A curious mind. You're always learning, always testing, always a few steps ahead.

- The ability to explain complex ideas in a simple way, especially for merchants who aren't technical.

Experience

- Previous experience in technical support at a SaaS or tech company

- Familiarity with HelpScout or other ticketing systems

- Hands-on knowledge of front-end development (HTML, CSS, browser dev tools)

- Working understanding of REST APIs and common data formats like JSON or XML

- Comfort with debugging using Chrome DevTools, especially for browser or front-end issues

- Knowledge of how HTTP and DNS work

- Experience reading API documentation and troubleshooting third-party integrations or custom app setups

- Some exposure to GraphQL APIs

Bonus experience

- Shopify theme development and Liquid: Knowing how themes interact with app blocks, line item properties, and cart/checkout logic helps when diagnosing visual or UX issues on merchant stores.

- Understanding of Shopify's admin and storefront APIs: Familiarity with how Shopify's APIs behave (especially in headless or custom setups) can be useful when troubleshooting sync issues, metafields, or app-triggered updates.

Beyond expertise, success in this role means embodying 3 core values

- Resourcefulness: You're relentlessly resourceful and always find ways to achieve the highest standards of quality. You know where to look and whom to consult when faced with challenges.

- Ownership: You take complete ownership and pride in your work. This means deeply understanding our existing and prospective merchants, as well as our product.

- Communication: You're clear, thoughtful, and intentional in how you communicate with both merchants and teammates. You surface issues early, share relevant context, and keep things moving without needing constant follow-up.

We're async by default

If you've ever ended a day of back-to-back meetings wondering when you were supposed to get any actual work done, we get it. We've been there. We've built a culture that protects time, encourages focus, and trusts you to do great work without constant check-ins.

We meet once a week for 30 min on Mondays. The rest of the time, we default to async: clear Slack threads, thoughtful Looms, and shared docs.

Perks & compensation

- Competitive salary + annual pay increases.

- $1,000 annual workspace stipend for laptop, headphones, or that standing desk you've been eyeing.

- Flexible hours. Work when you're most productive. We just ask for ~4 hours of overlap with Eastern Time (9 am to 5 pm EST).

- Flexible vacation policy. Take the time you need, no arbitrary caps.

Our interview process

- Application & short demo video: Submit your application plus the two-minute recorded screen-share. Both founders watch every submission, so take the chance to show how you think, not just what you click.

- Conversation with the co-founders (30 min): Meet Lichen (CEO) and Basil (CTO). We'll talk about projects you've worked on, how you approach support and problem-solving, and what kind of work energizes you.

- Paid take-home assignment: We'll send you a real-life merchant scenario to work through and pay you $100 USD for your time.

- Reference chats: We'll speak with two people you've worked with to understand your collaboration style and strengths.

- Offer: If it's a match, we move quickly, answer any final questions, and welcome you to the team.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/freshly-commerce-technical-support-specialist-1
